content.relationship.evt-catcher-sign.qu.ko: “또 사인이 세 번 바뀌었어. …이럴 거면 왜 나랑 배터리를 맞춰?”
content.relationship.evt-catcher-sign.qu.en: “That is three crossed-up signs. …Why bother working as a battery if you are going to change everything?”
content.relationship.evt-catcher-sign.qu.ja: 「またサインが三回変わった。…これじゃ、なんで俺とバッテリー組むんだ？」

content.relationship.evt-catcher-sign.qu.ko: “오늘 사인이 세 번이나 바뀌었어. 내가 놓친 게 뭐였어?”
content.relationship.evt-catcher-sign.qu.en: “We changed signs three times today. What did I miss?”
content.relationship.evt-catcher-sign.qu.ja: 「今日はサインが三回も変わった。俺が見逃したのは何だった？」

content.relationship.evt-coach-bench.cho.en: Request one chance to prove you can throw today.
content.relationship.evt-coach-bench.cho.ja: 今日投げられることを証明するチャンスを 1 回リクエストしてください。

content.relationship.evt-coach-bench.cho.ko: 불펜 투구를 보고 결정해 달라고 한다
content.relationship.evt-coach-bench.cho.ja: ブルペンテストをお願いします

content.relationship.evt-coach-bench.cho.en: Be direct about how your body has felt.
content.relationship.evt-coach-bench.cho.ja: 自分の体がどのように感じたかを率直に伝えましょう。

content.relationship.evt-coach-bench.cho.en: Hear exactly which movement your coach saw.
content.relationship.evt-coach-bench.cho.ja: コーチがどの動きを見たのかを正確に聞きます。
何が遅かったのか尋ねる

content.relationship.evt-coach-bench.quo.ko: “하루 쉬자. %@가 무리하는 걸 알면서 내보내면, 그건 내 잘못이 되니까.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-bench.quo.en: “Take a day, %@. If I send you out knowing you are pushing too hard, that is on me.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-bench.quo.ja: 「一日休め。%@が無理してると分かってて出したら、それは俺の責任だ。」

content.relationship.evt-coach-bench.quo.ko: “하루 쉬자. {player}가 무리하는 걸 알면서 내보내면, 그건 내 잘못이 되니까.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-bench.quo.en: “Take a day, {player}. If I send you out knowing you are pushing too hard, that is on me.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-bench.quo.ja: 「一日休め。{player}が無理してると分かってて出したら、それは俺の責任だ。」

content.relationship.evt-coach-bench.quo.ko: “오늘은 뺀다. 몸 상태를 나한테 숨기는 선수는 더 오래 못 믿어.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-bench.quo.en: “You are sitting today. I cannot trust a pitcher who hides how he feels.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-bench.quo.ja: 「今日は外す。体の状態を隠す選手は、長くは信じられない。」

content.relationship.evt-coach-bench.quo.ko: “이번 등판은 쉰다. 요즘은 팔이 몸보다 늦게 따라온다.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-bench.quo.en: “You are skipping this outing. Lately your arm has been a step behind the rest of you.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-bench.quo.ja: 「今回の登板は休め。最近は腕が体より遅れて来てる。」

content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.en: Choose the strength you trust most.
content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.ja: 最も信頼できる強度を選択してください。

content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.ko: 가장 자신 있는 공을 더 다듬겠다고 한다

content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.en: Name the moment you still need to fix.
content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.ja: まだ修正が必要な瞬間を挙げてください。

content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.en: Point to the last shaky inning
content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.ja: 不安定な最終回を指す

content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.en: Start with the coach’s final recommendation.
content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.ja: コーチの最終的な推奨事項から始めます。
彼が何を選ぶかを尋ねる

content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.ko: “마지막 훈련은 %@ 너한테 맡긴다. 3년을 봤으니, 이제 네 판단을 믿어 볼 때도 됐지.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.en: “The last workout is yours, %@. I have watched you for three years. It is time I trusted your judgment.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.ja: 「最後の練習は%@、お前に任せる。三年見てきた。そろそろお前の判断を信じてもいい頃だ。」

content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.ko: “마지막 훈련은 {player} 너한테 맡긴다. 3년을 봤으니, 이제 네 판단을 믿어 볼 때도 됐지.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.en: “The last workout is yours, {player}. I have watched you for three years. It is time I trusted your judgment.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.ja: 「最後の練習は{player}、お前に任せる。三年見てきた。そろそろお前の判断を信じてもいい頃だ。」

content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.ko: “마지막 훈련이다. …아직도 내가 정해 줘야 하나. 스스로 못 고르면 프로에선 더 헤맨다.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.en: “This is the last workout. …Do I still have to choose for you? If you cannot choose for yourself, pro ball will only get harder.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.ja: 「最後の練習だ。…まだ俺が決めてやらなきゃいけないのか。自分で選べなきゃ、プロではもっと迷うぞ。」

content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.ko: “마지막 훈련은 네가 정해라. 지금 가장 부족한 게 뭐지?”
content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.en: “You choose the last workout. What are you still missing?”
content.relationship.evt-coach-last-advi.ja: 「最後の練習はお前が決めろ。今一番足りないのは何だ？」

content.relationship.evt-coach-role.choi.en: Promise to prove it in the next outing.
content.relationship.evt-coach-role.choi.ja: 次の遠征でそれを証明すると約束してください。

content.relationship.evt-coach-role.choi.ko: 다음 등판으로 선발 자리를 되찾겠다고 한다
content.relationship.evt-coach-role.choi.ja: ローテーションスポットを取り戻す

content.relationship.evt-coach-role.choi.en: Explain why you still want a starter’s role.
content.relationship.evt-coach-role.choi.ja: それでもスターターの役割を望む理由を説明してください。

content.relationship.evt-coach-role.choi.ko: 최근 선발 등판 기록을 꺼내 보인다
content.relationship.evt-coach-role.choi.ja: 最近のスタートを表示

content.relationship.evt-coach-role.choi.en: Hear the weakness your coach sees first.
content.relationship.evt-coach-role.choi.ja: コーチが最初に認識している弱点を聞いてください。
役割が変わった理由を尋ねる

content.relationship.evt-coach-role.quot.ko: “%@. 이번엔 네가 경기 후반을 닫아 줘. 마지막 이닝은 아무한테나 안 맡긴다.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-role.quot.en: “%@. You are closing out the late innings this time. I do not give the final inning to just anyone.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-role.quot.ja: 「%@。今回はあなたが終盤のイニングを締めるのです。私は誰にも最終イニングを与えません。」

content.relationship.evt-coach-role.quot.ko: “{player}. 이번엔 네가 경기 후반을 닫아 줘. 마지막 이닝은 아무한테나 안 맡긴다.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-role.quot.en: “{player}. You are closing out the late innings this time. I do not give the final inning to just anyone.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-role.quot.ja: 「{player}。今回はあなたが終盤のイニングを締めるのです。私は誰にも最終イニングを与えません。」

content.relationship.evt-coach-role.quot.ko: “선발은 아직 이르다. 불펜부터 시작해. …이유를 따질 시간에 공이나 더 던져 봐.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-role.quot.en: “Starter is a long way off. Start in the bullpen. …You could throw more pitches instead of asking why.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-role.quot.ja: 「先発はまだ早い。ブルペンから始めろ。…理由を問う暇があったら、もう一球投げてみろ。」

content.relationship.evt-coach-role.quot.ko: “다음 대회는 불펜에서 시작한다. 경기 후반을 맡아 줘.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-role.quot.en: “You will start the next tournament in the bullpen. I need you for the late innings.”
content.relationship.evt-coach-role.quot.ja: 「次の大会はブルペンから始める。試合の後半を任せる。」

content.relationship.evt-command-wall.ch.ko: 실전 압박을 재현해 불펜 제구가 경기에서도 남는지 본다
content.relationship.evt-command-wall.ch.en: Recreate game pressure and see whether bullpen command survives it.
content.relationship.evt-command-wall.ch.ja: 試合のプレッシャーを再現し、ブルペンの指揮がそれに耐えられるかどうかを確認してください。

content.relationship.evt-command-wall.ch.en: Change the target with every count
content.relationship.evt-command-wall.ch.ja: カウントごとにターゲットを変更

content.relationship.evt-command-wall.ch.ko: 제구가 흐트러지는 원인을 다음 훈련의 기준점으로 남긴다
content.relationship.evt-command-wall.ch.en: Leave a visible checkpoint for the next command session.
content.relationship.evt-command-wall.ch.ja: 制球が乱れる原因を、次の練習の基準点として残す

content.relationship.evt-command-wall.ch.en: Mark the frame where the front foot opens
content.relationship.evt-command-wall.ch.ja: 前足が開くフレームに印を付けます

content.relationship.evt-command-wall.ch.ko: 빈 타석의 편안함을 버리고 경기와 같은 시야를 만든다
content.relationship.evt-command-wall.ch.en: Give up the comfort of an empty box and recreate the game view.
content.relationship.evt-command-wall.ch.ja: 空箱の快適さをあきらめて、試合の世界観を再現しましょう。

content.relationship.evt-command-wall.ch.ko: 타자 모형을 세우고 낮은 바깥쪽만 노린다
content.relationship.evt-command-wall.ch.en: Set up a hitter dummy and aim only low and away
content.relationship.evt-command-wall.ch.ja: 打者ダミーを設置し、低く、遠くだけを狙います

content.relationship.evt-command-wall.qu.ko: “%@, 불펜의 공은 충분해. 이제 타자를 세워 놓고도 그 선을 지키는 연습만 남았다.”
content.relationship.evt-command-wall.qu.en: “%@, the bullpen pitch is already good enough. Now keep that line with a hitter standing in.”
content.relationship.evt-command-wall.qu.ja: 「%@、ブルペンの投球はもう十分です。次は打者を立たせてそのラインを守りましょう。」

content.relationship.evt-command-wall.qu.ko: “{player}, 불펜의 공은 충분해. 이제 타자를 세워 놓고도 그 선을 지키는 연습만 남았다.”
content.relationship.evt-command-wall.qu.en: “{player}, the bullpen pitch is already good enough. Now keep that line with a hitter standing in.”
content.relationship.evt-command-wall.qu.ja: 「{player}、ブルペンの投球はもう十分です。次は打者を立たせてそのラインを守りましょう。」

content.relationship.evt-command-wall.qu.ko: “불펜 포수 미트만 맞히면 뭐 하나. 타자가 서면 또 한 뼘 빠지는데.”
content.relationship.evt-command-wall.qu.en: “What good is hitting the bullpen mitt if every pitch misses by a handspan once a hitter steps in?”
content.relationship.evt-command-wall.qu.ja: 「ブルペンのミットに当てて何になる。打者が立てばまた一つ分外れるのに。」

content.relationship.evt-command-wall.qu.ko: “타자가 서는 순간 앞발이 빨리 열린다. 공이 아니라 시선을 먼저 고쳐 보자.”
content.relationship.evt-command-wall.qu.en: “Your front foot opens as soon as a hitter stands there. Let us fix your eyes before the ball.”
content.relationship.evt-command-wall.qu.ja: 「打者が立った瞬間に前足が早く開く。球じゃなく、まず目線を直そう。」

content.relationship.evt-deja-vu-mound.c.en: Believe the memory and use it on the mound.
content.relationship.evt-deja-vu-mound.c.ja: その記憶を信じてマウンドで活かしましょう。
私がすでに知っていることを信頼してください

content.relationship.evt-deja-vu-mound.c.en: Put the first hitter in this life ahead of the déjà vu.
content.relationship.evt-deja-vu-mound.c.ja: デジャブの先に、この世の先頭打者を置く。

content.relationship.evt-deja-vu-mound.c.ko: 마운드 흙을 다시 밟으며 호흡을 센다
content.relationship.evt-deja-vu-mound.c.en: Step on the mound dirt again and count each breath
content.relationship.evt-deja-vu-mound.c.ja: もう一度マウンドの土を踏み、息を数える

content.relationship.evt-deja-vu-mound.c.en: Do not push away what is coming back.
content.relationship.evt-deja-vu-mound.c.ja: 戻ってくるものを押しのけないでください。
気持ちに従ってください

content.relationship.evt-deja-vu-mound.q.ko: 처음 오르는 마운드다. 그런데 발끝이 흙을 파는 각도까지 이미 몸이 알고 있다.
content.relationship.evt-deja-vu-mound.q.en: It is my first time on this mound. Yet my body already knows the angle my toes should dig into the dirt.
content.relationship.evt-deja-vu-mound.q.ja: このマウンドに立つのは初めて。それでも私の体は、つま先が土に食い込む角度をすでに知っています。

content.relationship.evt-deja-vu-mound.q.ko: 처음 오르는 마운드다. 그런데 발끝이 흙을 파는 각도까지 이미 몸이 알고 있다.
content.relationship.evt-deja-vu-mound.q.en: It is my first time on this mound. Yet my body already knows the angle my toes should dig into the dirt.
content.relationship.evt-deja-vu-mound.q.ja: このマウンドに立つのは初めて。それでも私の体は、つま先が土に食い込む角度をすでに知っています。

content.relationship.evt-deja-vu-mound.q.ko: 처음 오르는 마운드다. 그런데 발끝이 흙을 파는 각도까지 이미 몸이 알고 있다.
content.relationship.evt-deja-vu-mound.q.en: It is my first time on this mound. Yet my body already knows the angle my toes should dig into the dirt.
content.relationship.evt-deja-vu-mound.q.ja: このマウンドに立つのは初めて。それでも私の体は、つま先が土に食い込む角度をすでに知っています。

content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.ko: 말의 자신감만큼 경기 후 평가가 크게 움직인다
content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.en: Put your confidence—and the report—on what happens after fatigue arrives.
content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.ja: 疲労が来た後に何が起こるかについて、自信を持って報告してください。

content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.ko: 다음 등판의 마지막 이닝까지 보라고 한다
content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.en: Tell the scout to stay through your final inning
content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.ja: スカウトに最終回まで残るように伝えてください

content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.ko: 낮은 기록 뒤에 이어진 변화를 평가 자료에 보탠다
content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.en: Add the work after the poor results to the evaluation.
content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.ja: 悪い結果が出た後の作業も評価に加えます。

content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.ko: 최근 제구 수정 과정을 짧게 전한다
content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.en: Briefly describe the recent command adjustment
content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.ja: 最近の制球調整について簡単に説明します

content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.ko: 막연한 순위 불안 대신 다음 등판에서 바꿀 한 가지를 얻는다
content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.en: Trade vague draft anxiety for one target you can change next start.
content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.ja: 漠然としたドラフト不安を、次のスタートで変更できる 1 つの目標と交換しましょう。

content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.en: Ask which evaluation line is holding you down
content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.ja: どの評価ラインがあなたを足かせにしているかを尋ねる

content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.ko: “%@, 기사보다 현장이 늦게 움직일 때도 있다. 다음 등판이면 표를 바꿀 근거가 생겨.”
content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.en: “%@, sometimes the field moves later than the articles. One more start could give us reason to change the board.”
content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.ja: 「%@、記事より現場が遅れて動く時もある。次の登板があれば、評価を変える根拠ができる。」

content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.ko: “{player}, 기사보다 현장이 늦게 움직일 때도 있다. 다음 등판이면 표를 바꿀 근거가 생겨.”
content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.en: “{player}, sometimes the field moves later than the articles. One more start could give us reason to change the board.”
content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.ja: 「{player}、記事より現場が遅れて動く時もある。次の登板があれば、評価を変える根拠ができる。」

content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.ko: “기사의 라운드보다 우리 기록표가 낮다. 지금은 그 차이를 인정해야 해.”
content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.en: “Our report is lower than the round in the article. Right now you need to accept that gap.”
content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.ja: 「我々のレポートは記事のラウンドよりも低い。今はそのギャップを受け入れる必要がある。」

content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.ko: “예상 순위는 두 라운드 높더군. 우리는 최근 세 경기의 제구를 더 무겁게 본다.”
content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.en: “The projection had you two rounds higher. We weigh the command in your last three games more heavily.”
content.relationship.evt-draft-projectio.ja: 「予想順位は二ラウンド上だったな。うちは直近三試合の制球をもっと重く見る。」

content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.ch.ko: 빠른 기회를 원한다는 뜻과 그에 따른 경쟁을 받아들인다
content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.ch.en: Ask for an early chance and accept the competition attached to it.
content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.ch.ja: 早めのチャンスを求めて、それに付随する競争を受け入れてください。

content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.ch.en: Say you will earn a place in short outings first
content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.ch.ja: まずは短い登板で場所を稼ぐと言う

content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.ch.ko: 새 훈련표가 내 강점을 지우지 않도록 기준을 공유한다
content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.ch.en: Give the new plan a boundary that preserves your strength.
content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.ch.ja: 新しい計画に、あなたの力を維持できる境界線を与えてください。

content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.ch.en: Share the routine you protected in high school
content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.ch.ja: 高校時代に守ってきたルーティンを共有する

content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.ch.ko: 입단의 흥분보다 새 경쟁에서 필요한 준비를 먼저 챙긴다
content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.ch.en: Prepare for the new competition before celebrating the call.
content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.ch.ja: 召集を祝う前に、新しい競争に向けて準備をしましょう。

content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.ch.en: Write down the first-season outing plan
content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.ch.ja: 最初のシーズンの登板計画を書き留める

content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.qu.ko: “%@ 선수, 지금 장점을 지우지 않는 선에서 첫 시즌을 설계했습니다. 함께 맞춰 봅시다.”
content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.qu.en: “%@, we designed year one without erasing what you do best. Let us fit it together.”
content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.qu.ja: 「%@選手、今の長所を消さない範囲で一年目を設計しました。一緒に合わせていきましょう。」

content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.qu.ko: “{player} 선수, 지금 장점을 지우지 않는 선에서 첫 시즌을 설계했습니다. 함께 맞춰 봅시다.”
content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.qu.en: “{player}, we designed year one without erasing what you do best. Let us fit it together.”
content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.qu.ja: 「{player}選手、今の長所を消さない範囲で一年目を設計しました。一緒に合わせていきましょう。」

content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.qu.ko: “입단 뒤엔 처음부터 다시 경쟁입니다. 고교 성적은 오늘까지만 봅니다.”
content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.qu.en: “After you sign, the competition starts over. We stop looking at high-school results today.”
content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.qu.ja: 「サインしたら、競争は最初からやり直しです。私たちは今日から高校の成績を見るのをやめます。」

content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.qu.ko: “첫 시즌은 몸부터 만들고 짧은 이닝으로 시작할 계획입니다. 본인 생각도 듣고 싶습니다.”
content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.qu.en: “The first-season plan builds your body first and starts with short outings. We want your view too.”
content.relationship.evt-drafted-call.qu.ja: 「一年目はまず体を作り、短いイニングから始める計画です。本人の考えも聞きたい。」

content.relationship.evt-exam-week.choic.en: Use the smaller window without giving up the work.
content.relationship.evt-exam-week.choic.ja: 作業を諦めずに小さいウィンドウを使用してください。
あらゆる練習時間を大切にしましょう

content.relationship.evt-exam-week.choic.ko: 둘 다 놓지 않을 계획을 설명한다
content.relationship.evt-exam-week.choic.en: Lay out a plan that protects both school and baseball.
content.relationship.evt-exam-week.choic.ja: 学校と野球の両方を守る計画を立てる。
時間分割について説明する

content.relationship.evt-exam-week.choic.ko: 원정 전까지 책상 앞에 앉을 시간을 확보한다
content.relationship.evt-exam-week.choic.en: Reserve time at the desk before the road trip.
content.relationship.evt-exam-week.choic.ja: 遠征の前にデスクで時間を予約してください。

content.relationship.evt-exam-week.choic.en: Copy the next few days of exam material into a notebook
content.relationship.evt-exam-week.choic.ja: 今後数日間の試験内容をノートにコピーします。

content.relationship.evt-exam-week.quote.ko: “%@, 시험이랑 원정이 겹쳤더라. 알아서 할 거 아니까 길게 말 안 한다. 며칠만.”
content.relationship.evt-exam-week.quote.en: “%@, your exams overlap with the road trip. I know you will handle it, so I will keep this short: just a few days.”
content.relationship.evt-exam-week.quote.ja: 「%@、試験と遠征が重なったな。自分でやれるのは分かってるから長くは言わない。数日だけだ。」

content.relationship.evt-exam-week.quote.ko: “{player}, 시험이랑 원정이 겹쳤더라. 알아서 할 거 아니까 길게 말 안 한다. 며칠만.”
content.relationship.evt-exam-week.quote.en: “{player}, your exams overlap with the road trip. I know you will handle it, so I will keep this short: just a few days.”
content.relationship.evt-exam-week.quote.ja: 「{player}、試験と遠征が重なったな。自分でやれるのは分かってるから長くは言わない。数日だけだ。」

content.relationship.evt-exam-week.quote.ko: “시험이랑 원정이 겹쳤지. 공만 잡고 있으면 나중에 갈 데가 좁아진다.”
content.relationship.evt-exam-week.quote.en: “The exam and road trip overlap. If all you do is hold a ball, your options will shrink later.”
content.relationship.evt-exam-week.quote.ja: 「試験と遠征が重なっています。ボールを持っているだけでは、後々選択肢が狭まってしまいます。」

content.relationship.evt-exam-week.quote.ko: “시험이랑 원정이 겹쳤지. 공만큼 책도 며칠은 잡아야 한다. …야구는 안 도망가.”
content.relationship.evt-exam-week.quote.en: “The exam and road trip overlap. You need a few days with your books too. …Baseball will still be here.”
content.relationship.evt-exam-week.quote.ja: 「試験と遠征が重なったな。球と同じくらい、本も数日は握れ。…野球は逃げない。」

content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.choi.en: Answer the expectation with a pitch in the game.
content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.choi.ja: 試合では投球で期待に応える。

content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.choi.en: Promise to throw it next game
content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.choi.ja: 次の試合で投げると約束する

content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.choi.en: Tell the fan why you keep throwing it.
content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.choi.ja: なぜ投げ続けるのかファンに伝えてください。

content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.choi.ko: 그 공을 던지는 이유를 답장에 적는다
content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.choi.ja: 投球について返信します

content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.choi.en: Find out which pitch the fan cares about most.
content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.choi.ja: ファンがどの投球を最も気にしているかを調べてください。
もう一度手紙を読んでください

content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.quot.ko: “그 느린 공 던질 때 제가 제일 크게 소리쳐요. 다음에도 던져 주실 거죠?” 편지가 세 장이나 왔다.
content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.quot.en: “I cheer the loudest when you throw that slow pitch. You will throw it again, right?” Three letters arrived.
content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.quot.ja: 「あの遅い球を投げるときが一番声援が大きいです。また投げますよね？」 ３通の手紙が届いた。

content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.quot.ko: “저번에 진 거 봤어요. 그래도 그 느린 공은 좋았어요.” 짧은 편지 한 장이다.
content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.quot.en: “I saw you lose last time. I still liked that slow pitch.” It was a short letter.
content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.quot.ja: 「前回負けたのを見ました。あの遅い投球はまだ好きでした」。それは短い手紙でした。

content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.quot.ko: “%@ 선수님이 던지는 그 느린 공이 제일 좋아요. 다음 경기에도 꼭 던져 주세요!” 삐뚤빼뚤한 글씨 밑에 그림도 그려져 있다.
content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.quot.en: “I love that slow pitch you throw, %@. Please throw it again next game!” A drawing sat beneath the crooked handwriting.
content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.quot.ja: 「あなたの投げる遅い球が大好きです、%@。次の試合でも投げてください！」曲がった手書きの下に絵が置かれていました。

content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.quot.ko: “{player} 선수님이 던지는 그 느린 공이 제일 좋아요. 다음 경기에도 꼭 던져 주세요!” 삐뚤빼뚤한 글씨 밑에 그림도 그려져 있다.
content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.quot.en: “I love that slow pitch you throw, {player}. Please throw it again next game!” A drawing sat beneath the crooked handwriting.
content.relationship.evt-fan-letter.quot.ja: 「あなたの投げる遅い球が大好きです、{player}。次の試合でも投げてください！」曲がった手書きの下に絵が置かれていました。

content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.ko: 확신을 얻을 수 있지만 흔들리면 경기 흐름까지 내준다
content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.en: Earn conviction, or lose the game’s momentum if it breaks down.
content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.ja: 確信を得るか、失敗した場合に試合の勢いを失います。

content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.ko: 가장 어려운 코스에 새 동작을 건다
content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.en: Use the new motion on the hardest target
content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.ja: 最も硬いターゲットに新しいモーションを使用する

content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.en: Leave a clue that can make the motion repeatable.
content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.ja: 動作を再現可能にする手がかりを残します。

content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.en: Mark the landing spot in the dugout
content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.ja: ダッグアウト内の着陸地点に印を付ける

content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.ko: 좋은 감각을 붙잡으려 힘주지 않고 몸의 순서를 지킨다
content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.en: Keep the body’s order without tightening up to hold the feeling.
content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.ja: 感覚を保持するために締め付けることなく、体の秩序を保ちます。

content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.ko: 다음 공도 같은 호흡으로 이어 간다
content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.en: Carry the same breath into the next pitch
content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.ja: 同じ呼吸を次の投球に持ち込む

content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.ko: 공을 놓기 전부터 미트가 가까워 보였다. 이제 이 동작은 빌린 감각이 아니라 내 것이었다.
content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.en: The mitt looked close before release. This motion was no longer borrowed; it belonged to me.
content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.ja: リリースの前からミットが近く見えた。もうこの動きは借り物の感覚じゃない、自分のものだった。

content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.ko: 훈련 때 붙잡으려 할수록 달아났던 동작이 경기에서 먼저 나왔다. 우연이라고 넘기기엔 공 끝이 달랐다.
content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.en: The motion that vanished whenever I chased it appeared first in the game. The finish on the ball was too different to dismiss.
content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.ja: 練習で掴もうとするほど逃げていた動きが、試合で先に出た。偶然で済ませるには球の切れが違った。

content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.ko: 앞발이 닿는 순간 팔이 늦지 않았다. 생각하기 전에 몸이 최근의 반복을 꺼냈다.
content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.en: My arm was not late when the front foot landed. My body retrieved the recent repetitions before I could think.
content.relationship.evt-first-awakening.ja: 前足の着地に私の腕は遅れなかった。考えるよりも先に、私の体は最近の繰り返しを思い出しました。

content.relationship.evt-future-news.cho.ko: 지난 삶에 없던 변수를 찾아 익숙한 결말을 흔든다
content.relationship.evt-future-news.cho.en: Search for a variable outside the old life and disturb the familiar ending.
content.relationship.evt-future-news.cho.ja: 昔の生活の外にある変数を探して、おなじみの結末を混乱させましょう。

content.relationship.evt-future-news.cho.en: Find a game from the team omitted from the forecast
content.relationship.evt-future-news.cho.ja: 予想から除外されたチームから試合を探す

content.relationship.evt-future-news.cho.ko: 정해진 결말보다 지금 바꿀 수 있는 한 칸에 집중한다
content.relationship.evt-future-news.cho.en: Focus on the one square you can change now instead of the fixed ending.
content.relationship.evt-future-news.cho.ja: 固定されたエンディングではなく、今変更できる 1 つのマスに焦点を当てます。

content.relationship.evt-future-news.cho.en: Turn off the radio and open today’s plan
content.relationship.evt-future-news.cho.ja: ラジオを消して今日の計画を開く

content.relationship.evt-future-news.cho.ko: 기억이 정확한지 확인해 이번 시즌의 지도로 삼는다
content.relationship.evt-future-news.cho.en: Test the memory before using it as a map for the season.
content.relationship.evt-future-news.cho.ja: 季節の地図として使用する前に、記憶力をテストしてください。

content.relationship.evt-future-news.cho.ko: 끝까지 들어 달라지는 이름이 있는지 센다
content.relationship.evt-future-news.cho.en: Listen through and count any changed names
content.relationship.evt-future-news.cho.ja: 変更された名前をすべて聞いて数えます

content.relationship.evt-future-news.quo.ko: 라디오는 올해 우승 후보를 지난 삶과 같은 순서로 읊는다. 결말을 아는 책이 다시 첫 장을 펼쳤다.
content.relationship.evt-future-news.quo.en: The radio lists the title favorites in the exact order from my last life. A book whose ending I know has opened again.
content.relationship.evt-future-news.quo.ja: ラジオが今年の優勝候補を、前の人生と同じ順で読み上げる。結末を知っている本が、また最初の章を開いた。

content.relationship.evt-future-news.quo.ko: 라디오는 올해 우승 후보를 지난 삶과 같은 순서로 읊는다. 결말을 아는 책이 다시 첫 장을 펼쳤다.
content.relationship.evt-future-news.quo.en: The radio lists the title favorites in the exact order from my last life. A book whose ending I know has opened again.
content.relationship.evt-future-news.quo.ja: ラジオが今年の優勝候補を、前の人生と同じ順で読み上げる。結末を知っている本が、また最初の章を開いた。

content.relationship.evt-future-news.quo.ko: 라디오는 올해 우승 후보를 지난 삶과 같은 순서로 읊는다. 결말을 아는 책이 다시 첫 장을 펼쳤다.
content.relationship.evt-future-news.quo.en: The radio lists the title favorites in the exact order from my last life. A book whose ending I know has opened again.
content.relationship.evt-future-news.quo.ja: ラジオが今年の優勝候補を、前の人生と同じ順で読み上げる。結末を知っている本が、また最初の章を開いた。

content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.choi.ko: 정해진 감각을 벗어나지만 익숙한 포구감도 포기한다
content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.choi.en: Leave the fixed feeling behind, along with its familiar catch.
content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.choi.ja: 慣れ親しんだキャッチーとともに、固定感を残してください。

content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.choi.en: Break it in deliberately the other way

content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.choi.ko: 지난 삶의 물건과 이번 삶의 시작을 구분할 표식을 남긴다
content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.choi.en: Mark a boundary between an object from the old life and this beginning.
content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.choi.ja: 昔の生活からの物体とこの始まりとの間に境界線を示します。

content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.choi.en: Write today’s date inside the glove
content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.choi.ja: 手袋の内側に今日の日付を書きます

content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.choi.ko: 몸의 기억을 받아들여 새 장비에 적응할 시간을 줄인다
content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.choi.en: Let body memory shorten the time needed to break in new leather.
content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.choi.ja: 体の記憶により、新しい革に慣れるまでの時間を短縮します。

content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.choi.en: Follow the path the glove already takes
content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.choi.ja: グローブがすでにたどった道をたどる

content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.quot.ko: 새 글러브가 처음부터 손바닥 안쪽으로 부드럽게 접힌다. 지난 삶에서 수백 번 닫았던 바로 그 각도다.
content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.quot.en: A new glove folds softly toward the palm from the start—the exact angle I closed hundreds of times in my last life.
content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.quot.ja: 新しいグローブが最初から手のひらの内側へ柔らかく折れる。前の人生で何百回も閉じた、まさにその角度だ。

content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.quot.ko: 새 글러브가 처음부터 손바닥 안쪽으로 부드럽게 접힌다. 지난 삶에서 수백 번 닫았던 바로 그 각도다.
content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.quot.en: A new glove folds softly toward the palm from the start—the exact angle I closed hundreds of times in my last life.
content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.quot.ja: 新しいグローブが最初から手のひらの内側へ柔らかく折れる。前の人生で何百回も閉じた、まさにその角度だ。

content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.quot.ko: 새 글러브가 처음부터 손바닥 안쪽으로 부드럽게 접힌다. 지난 삶에서 수백 번 닫았던 바로 그 각도다.
content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.quot.en: A new glove folds softly toward the palm from the start—the exact angle I closed hundreds of times in my last life.
content.relationship.evt-glove-worn.quot.ja: 新しいグローブが最初から手のひらの内側へ柔らかく折れる。前の人生で何百回も閉じた、まさにその角度だ。

content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.ch.ko: 문제가 없음을 보일 수 있지만 통증을 키울 위험도 남는다
content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.ch.en: You may prove nothing is wrong, but you may also deepen the pain.
content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.ch.ja: 何も問題がないと証明できるかもしれませんが、痛みがさらに深まる可能性もあります。

content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.ch.ko: 불펜 열 공 뒤 다시 보자고 한다
content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.ch.en: Ask to reassess after ten bullpen pitches
content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.ch.ja: 10回のブルペン投球後に再評価を求める

content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.ch.ko: 소문 대신 기록으로 몸 상태를 판단하게 한다
content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.ch.en: Replace rumor with a record the staff can evaluate.
content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.ch.ja: 噂ではなく、首脳陣が評価できる記録で示す。

content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.ch.en: Name the date the stiffness began
content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.ch.ja: 硬直が始まった日付を記入してください

content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.ch.ko: 등판 기회가 미뤄져도 작은 통증을 부상 전에 잡는다
content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.ch.en: Risk a delayed outing to catch a small pain before it becomes an injury.
content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.ch.ja: 軽い痛みが怪我になる前に対処するために、登板を遅らせる危険を冒してください。

content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.ch.en: Go to the trainer’s room together
content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.ch.ja: 一緒にトレーナールームへ行く

content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.qu.ko: “%@, 네가 숨길 때 어떤 표정인지 알아. 오늘은 나랑 바로 가자.”
content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.qu.en: “%@, I know the face you make when you hide something. We are going now.”
content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.qu.ja: 「%@、あなたが何かを隠すときの顔は知っています。私たちは今から行きます。」

content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.qu.ko: “{player}, 네가 숨길 때 어떤 표정인지 알아. 오늘은 나랑 바로 가자.”
content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.qu.en: “{player}, I know the face you make when you hide something. We are going now.”
content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.qu.ja: 「{player}、あなたが何かを隠すときの顔は知っています。私たちは今から行きます。」

content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.qu.ko: “어깨 계속 만지잖아. 네가 말 안 하면 내가 코치한테 말할 거야.”
content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.qu.en: “You keep touching that shoulder. If you will not tell the coach, I will.”
content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.qu.ja: 「あなたはその肩を触り続けています。あなたがコーチに言わないなら、私が言います。」

content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.qu.ko: “두 번 봤어. 괜찮다면 왜 자꾸 같은 데를 눌러? 같이 트레이너한테 가자.”
content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.qu.en: “I saw it twice. If it is fine, why press the same spot? Come to the trainer with me.”
content.relationship.evt-injury-rumor.qu.ja: 「二回見た。平気なら、なんで同じ所ばかり押すの？一緒にトレーナーの所へ行こう。」

content.relationship.evt-known-coach.cho.en: Use the memory before it fades.
content.relationship.evt-known-coach.cho.ja: 記憶が薄れる前に使い切ってください。
知っていることに基づいて行動する

content.relationship.evt-known-coach.cho.en: Put the strange recognition into words.
content.relationship.evt-known-coach.cho.ja: 不思議な認識を言葉にしてみる。
なじみのあるものを説明する

content.relationship.evt-known-coach.cho.en: Listen for the part you remember.
content.relationship.evt-known-coach.cho.ja: 覚えている部分を聞いてください。
おなじみのアドバイスに従ってください

content.relationship.evt-known-coach.quo.ko: 감독의 말버릇이 낯익다. 다음에 무슨 말을 할지 알 것 같은데, 만난 적은 없다.
content.relationship.evt-known-coach.quo.en: Your coach’s mannerisms feel familiar. You almost know what he will say next, but you have never met.
content.relationship.evt-known-coach.quo.ja: コーチの態度には見覚えがあるような気がします。彼が次に何を言うかはほぼわかっていますが、会ったことがありません。

content.relationship.evt-known-coach.quo.ko: 감독의 말버릇이 낯익다. 다음에 무슨 말을 할지 알 것 같은데, 만난 적은 없다.
content.relationship.evt-known-coach.quo.en: Your coach’s mannerisms feel familiar. You almost know what he will say next, but you have never met.
content.relationship.evt-known-coach.quo.ja: コーチの態度には見覚えがあるような気がします。彼が次に何を言うかはほぼわかっていますが、会ったことがありません。

content.relationship.evt-known-coach.quo.ko: 감독의 말버릇이 낯익다. 다음에 무슨 말을 할지 알 것 같은데, 만난 적은 없다.
content.relationship.evt-known-coach.quo.en: Your coach’s mannerisms feel familiar. You almost know what he will say next, but you have never met.
content.relationship.evt-known-coach.quo.ja: コーチの態度には見覚えがあるような気がします。彼が次に何を言うかはほぼわかっていますが、会ったことがありません。

content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.ch.ko: 논쟁을 다음 경기까지 끌지 않고 훈련장에서 결론낸다
content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.ch.en: Settle the debate in practice instead of carrying it into the next game.
content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.ch.ja: 議論を次の試合に持ち込むのではなく、実際の試合で決着をつけましょう。

content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.ch.ko: 같은 타자를 세워 두 배합을 모두 시험한다
content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.ch.en: Test both sequences against the same hitter
content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.ch.ja: 同じ打者に対して両方のシーケンスをテストする

content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.ch.ko: 독단이 아니라 근거 있는 선택이었다는 점을 공유한다
content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.ch.en: Share that the pitch was a reasoned choice, not a solo decision.
content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.ch.ja: この売り込みは単独での決断ではなく、合理的な選択だったということを共有しましょう。

content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.ch.ko: 헛스윙을 노린 타자 습관을 영상으로 보여준다
content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.ch.en: Show the hitter tendency behind the whiff call
content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.ch.ja: 空振りを狙った根拠となる打者の癖を映像で見せる

content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.ch.ko: 다음 만루에는 배터리의 첫 판단을 한곳에 모은다
content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.ch.en: Bring the battery’s first decision together for the next bases-loaded spot.
content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.ch.ja: 次の満塁に向けてバッテリーの最初の決断を結集させる。

content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.ch.ko: 포수가 원했던 낮은 코스를 화면에 찍는다
content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.ch.en: Mark the low target the catcher wanted
content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.ch.ja: 捕手が望んでいた低いターゲットをマークする

content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.qu.ko: “%@, 그 초구 선택은 틀리지 않았어. 다만 다음엔 내가 왜 그 공인지 먼저 알고 싶어.”
content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.qu.en: “%@, that first-pitch choice was not wrong. I just want to know why before we throw it next time.”
content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.qu.ja: 「%@、あの初球の選択は間違っていませんでした。次に投げる前に理由を知りたいだけです。」

content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.qu.ko: “{player}, 그 초구 선택은 틀리지 않았어. 다만 다음엔 내가 왜 그 공인지 먼저 알고 싶어.”
content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.qu.en: “{player}, that first-pitch choice was not wrong. I just want to know why before we throw it next time.”
content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.qu.ja: 「{player}、あの初球の選択は間違っていませんでした。次に投げる前に理由を知りたいだけです。」

content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.qu.ko: “그때도 네가 고개 저었지. 또 만루가 오면 이번엔 내 사인 볼 거야?”
content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.qu.en: “You shook me off then too. If the bases load again, will you look at my sign this time?”
content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.qu.ja: 「あのときも振り切ったね。また満塁になったら、今度は僕のサインを見る？」

content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.qu.ko: “만루 초구, 나는 땅볼을 원했고 넌 헛스윙을 노렸어. 다음엔 하나로 맞추자.”
content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.qu.en: “With the bases loaded, I wanted a grounder and you wanted a swing-and-miss. Next time we choose one.”
content.relationship.evt-loaded-bases.qu.ja: 「満塁の初球、俺はゴロが欲しくて、お前は空振りを狙った。次は一つに決めよう。」

content.relationship.evt-loss-interview..en: Let the next result speak for you.
content.relationship.evt-loss-interview..ja: 次の結果がすべてを物語ります。
次の試合で答えてください

content.relationship.evt-loss-interview..en: Walk through the decision you made in that moment.
content.relationship.evt-loss-interview..ja: その瞬間に下した決断を振り返ってみましょう。

content.relationship.evt-loss-interview..en: Make sure you understand the question before answering.
content.relationship.evt-loss-interview..ja: 回答する前に質問を理解していることを確認してください。
記者が何を言いたいのか尋ねる

content.relationship.evt-loss-interview..ko: “%@ 선수, 마지막 그 공 노리고 던진 거죠? 그 판단이 궁금해서 기다렸습니다.”
content.relationship.evt-loss-interview..en: “%@, you meant to throw that last pitch, right? I waited because I wanted to understand the call.”
content.relationship.evt-loss-interview..ja: 「%@、最後の球を投げるつもりだったんですよね？コールを理解したかったので待っていました。」

content.relationship.evt-loss-interview..ko: “{player} 선수, 마지막 그 공 노리고 던진 거죠? 그 판단이 궁금해서 기다렸습니다.”
content.relationship.evt-loss-interview..en: “{player}, you meant to throw that last pitch, right? I waited because I wanted to understand the call.”
content.relationship.evt-loss-interview..ja: 「{player}、最後の球を投げるつもりだったんですよね？コールを理解したかったので待っていました。」

content.relationship.evt-loss-interview..ko: “마지막 그 공, 실투였습니까?” 녹음기가 아직 돌아가고 있다.
content.relationship.evt-loss-interview..en: “Was that last pitch a mistake?” The recorder was still running.
content.relationship.evt-loss-interview..ja: 「あの最後の投球は間違いだったのか？」レコーダーはまだ動いていた。

content.relationship.evt-loss-interview..ko: “마지막 타자에게 그 공을 고른 이유가 있었나요?” 녹음기가 아직 돌아가고 있다.
content.relationship.evt-loss-interview..en: “Why did you choose that pitch to the final batter?” The recorder was still running.
content.relationship.evt-loss-interview..ja: 「なぜ最後の打者にあの球を選んだのですか？」レコーダーはまだ動いていた。

content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.c.ko: 작별을 공의 감촉으로 남긴다. 미련도 같이 돌아올 수 있다
content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.c.en: Leave the farewell in the feel of the ball. Regret may come back with it.
content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.c.ja: 別れをボールの感触に残す。未練も一緒に戻ってくるかもしれない

content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.c.en: Ask for one final game of catch
content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.c.ja: 最後のキャッチボールをお願いします

content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.c.ko: 다른 길로 가도 관계가 끝나는 것은 아님을 전한다
content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.c.en: Let the relationship continue even when the paths split.
content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.c.ja: たとえ道が分かれたとしても、関係は続いていきましょう。

content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.c.ko: 함께 던졌던 시간을 잊지 않겠다고 한다
content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.c.en: Say you will remember the time you pitched together
content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.c.ja: 一緒に投げたときのことを覚えていると言ってください

content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.c.ko: 붙잡는 말보다 친구가 고른 삶을 존중한다
content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.c.en: Respect the life your friend chose before reaching for words that pull him back.
content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.c.ja: 友人を引き戻すような言葉に手を伸ばす前に、友人が選んだ人生を尊重してください。

content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.c.en: Ask what happened, one step at a time
content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.c.ja: 何が起こったのかを一度に一歩ずつ尋ねてください

content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.q.ko: 지난 삶에서 끝까지 함께 던졌던 동료가 이번에는 유니폼을 벗었다. “이번엔 여기까지 할래. 너는 계속 던져.”
content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.q.en: The teammate who pitched beside me to the end in my last life has taken off the uniform this time. “This is it for me. You keep pitching.”
content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.q.ja: 前の人生で最後まで一緒に投げた仲間が、今度はユニホームを脱いだ。「今回はここまでにする。お前は投げ続けろ」

content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.q.ko: 지난 삶에서 끝까지 함께 던졌던 동료가 이번에는 유니폼을 벗었다. “이번엔 여기까지 할래. 너는 계속 던져.”
content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.q.en: The teammate who pitched beside me to the end in my last life has taken off the uniform this time. “This is it for me. You keep pitching.”
content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.q.ja: 前の人生で最後まで一緒に投げた仲間が、今度はユニホームを脱いだ。「今回はここまでにする。お前は投げ続けろ」

content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.q.ko: 지난 삶에서 끝까지 함께 던졌던 동료가 이번에는 유니폼을 벗었다. “이번엔 여기까지 할래. 너는 계속 던져.”
content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.q.en: The teammate who pitched beside me to the end in my last life has taken off the uniform this time. “This is it for me. You keep pitching.”
content.relationship.evt-lost-teammate.q.ja: 前の人生で最後まで一緒に投げた仲間が、今度はユニホームを脱いだ。「今回はここまでにする。お前は投げ続けろ」

content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.ko: 빠른 교정을 노리지만 감각이 어긋나면 투구 수가 늘어난다
content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.en: A quick fix is possible, but a missed feel adds pitches to the session.
content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.ja: 素早い修正は可能ですが、感覚を逃すとセッションに投球が追加されます。

content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.ko: 바로 마운드에서 수정 동작을 던져 본다
content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.en: Try the adjustment from the mound immediately
content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.ja: 早速マウンドから調整を試す

content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.ko: 달라진 두 프레임을 눈으로 남겨 혼자서도 교정할 수 있게 한다
content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.en: Keep a visual record of the two-frame change for self-correction.
content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.ja: 自己修正のために 2 フレームの変化を視覚的に記録してください。

content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.en: Overlay the clip with a good delivery
content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.ja: クリップを適切な配信でオーバーレイする

content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.ko: 구속을 잠시 내려놓고 릴리스의 기준점을 되찾는다
content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.en: Set velocity aside and recover the release checkpoint.
content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.ja: 球速をいったん脇に置き、リリースの基準点を取り戻す

content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.ko: 공 없이 앞어깨를 닫는 동작부터 반복한다
content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.en: Repeat the closed-shoulder move without a ball
content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.ja: ボールを持たずに肩を閉じた動きを繰り返す

content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.ko: “%@, 차이는 딱 두 프레임이다. 네 몸이면 오늘 안에 되찾을 수 있어.”
content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.en: “%@, it is only two frames. Your body can find them again today.”
content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.ja: 「%@、差はたった2フレームだ。お前の体なら今日中に取り戻せる」

content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.ko: “{player}, 차이는 딱 두 프레임이다. 네 몸이면 오늘 안에 되찾을 수 있어.”
content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.en: “{player}, it is only two frames. Your body can find them again today.”
content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.ja: 「{player}、差はたった2フレームだ。お前の体なら今日中に取り戻せる」

content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.ko: “네가 괜찮다 해도 화면엔 손이 먼저 나가. 이대로면 높은 공이 계속 빠진다.”
content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.en: “You can say you feel fine, but the camera shows an early release. The high misses will keep coming.”
content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.ja: 「本人が大丈夫だと言っても、映像では手が先に出ている。このままだと高めに抜け続けるぞ」

content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.ko: “공이 손에서 두 프레임 일찍 떨어진다. 앞쪽 어깨가 버티는 시간을 늘려 보자.”
content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.en: “The ball leaves two frames early. Let us keep the front shoulder closed a little longer.”
content.relationship.evt-mechanics-camer.ja: 「ボールが２コマ早く離れる。もう少し前肩を閉じておこう」。

content.relationship.evt-memory-ache.cho.en: Accept the risk and keep the career moving.
content.relationship.evt-memory-ache.cho.ja: リスクを受け入れてキャリアを進めてください。

content.relationship.evt-memory-ache.cho.en: Tell someone why this week feels different.
content.relationship.evt-memory-ache.cho.ja: 今週はいつもと違うと感じる理由を誰かに話してください。
覚えていることを説明してください

content.relationship.evt-memory-ache.cho.en: Treat the warning as useful information.
content.relationship.evt-memory-ache.cho.ja: 警告は有益な情報として扱ってください。
痛みが再発する前に休んでください

content.relationship.evt-memory-ache.quo.ko: 지난번에 팔이 나갔던 바로 그 주차다. 아프지 않은데 그 자리가 계속 신경 쓰인다.
content.relationship.evt-memory-ache.quo.en: This is the week my arm gave out last time. Nothing hurts, but I cannot stop noticing that spot.
content.relationship.evt-memory-ache.quo.ja: 前回、腕が壊れたのと同じ週だ。痛くはないのに、あの場所がずっと気になる。

content.relationship.evt-memory-ache.quo.ko: 지난번에 팔이 나갔던 바로 그 주차다. 아프지 않은데 그 자리가 계속 신경 쓰인다.
content.relationship.evt-memory-ache.quo.en: This is the week my arm gave out last time. Nothing hurts, but I cannot stop noticing that spot.
content.relationship.evt-memory-ache.quo.ja: 前回、腕が壊れたのと同じ週だ。痛くはないのに、あの場所がずっと気になる。

content.relationship.evt-memory-ache.quo.ko: 지난번에 팔이 나갔던 바로 그 주차다. 아프지 않은데 그 자리가 계속 신경 쓰인다.
content.relationship.evt-memory-ache.quo.en: This is the week my arm gave out last time. Nothing hurts, but I cannot stop noticing that spot.
content.relationship.evt-memory-ache.quo.ja: 前回、腕が壊れたのと同じ週だ。痛くはないのに、あの場所がずっと気になる。

content.relationship.evt-national-stage..en: Put the broadcast aside and throw the pitch.
content.relationship.evt-national-stage..ja: 放送を脇に置き、投球を投げます。
カメラのことは忘れてください

content.relationship.evt-national-stage..en: Make clear that the routine is not changing.
content.relationship.evt-national-stage..ja: ルーチンが変わっていないことを明確にします。
普通に準備するって言って

content.relationship.evt-national-stage..ko: 루틴을 끊지 않을 공간을 미리 확보한다
content.relationship.evt-national-stage..en: Secure enough space to keep the routine uninterrupted.
content.relationship.evt-national-stage..ja: 日常生活を妨げない十分なスペースを確保してください。

content.relationship.evt-national-stage..ko: 카메라가 지날 선을 바닥에 짚어 달라 한다
content.relationship.evt-national-stage..en: Ask the crew to mark the camera path on the floor
content.relationship.evt-national-stage..ja: 乗組員に床にカメラのパスをマークするよう依頼します。

content.relationship.evt-national-stage..ko: “오늘은 %@ 중심으로 간다. 평소대로만 하면 그림은 알아서 나와.”
content.relationship.evt-national-stage..en: “Today we're building around you, %@. Throw like always and the shots take care of themselves.”
content.relationship.evt-national-stage..ja: 「今日は%@を中心に撮る。いつも通りやれば、絵は勝手についてくる」

content.relationship.evt-national-stage..ko: “오늘은 {player} 중심으로 간다. 평소대로만 하면 그림은 알아서 나와.”
content.relationship.evt-national-stage..en: “Today we're building around you, {player}. Throw like always and the shots take care of themselves.”
content.relationship.evt-national-stage..ja: 「今日は{player}を中心に撮る。いつも通りやれば、絵は勝手についてくる」

content.relationship.evt-national-stage..ko: “오늘 불펜부터 카메라 붙는다. 부담되면 어쩔 수 없고.”
content.relationship.evt-national-stage..en: “The cameras are on you from the bullpen today. If that bothers you, that is how it is.”
content.relationship.evt-national-stage..ja: 「今日はブルペンからカメラがつく。気になるなら仕方ないが」

content.relationship.evt-national-stage..ko: “오늘 불펜부터 그림 좀 담을게. 평소대로 던져. …평소대로가 제일 어렵지?”
content.relationship.evt-national-stage..en: “We'll get some shots from the bullpen. Throw like always. …Which is the hardest part, right?”
content.relationship.evt-national-stage..ja: 「今日はブルペンから少し撮らせてもらう。いつも通り投げて。…いつも通りが一番難しいだろ？」

content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.cho.en: Compare them before the game decides for you.
content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.cho.ja: 試合で勝敗が決まる前に、それらを比較してください。

content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.cho.ko: 불펜에서 두 방식을 모두 시험하자고 한다
content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.cho.en: Test both systems in the bullpen
content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.cho.ja: ブルペンで両方のシステムをテストする

content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.cho.en: Explain why changing now could create mistakes.
content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.cho.ja: 今変更すると間違いが生じる可能性がある理由を説明します。

content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.cho.ko: 기존 사인을 유지하고 싶은 이유를 말한다
content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.cho.ja: 古い看板をそのままにしておきます

content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.cho.en: Start by understanding the catcher’s familiar system.
content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.cho.ja: まずは捕手の使い慣れたシステムを理解することから始めましょう。

content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.quo.ko: “전 학교 사인이 손에 더 붙어. 근데 %@가 편한 쪽으로 가자. 나는 맞출 수 있어.”
content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.quo.en: “The signs from my old school still feel natural. But let us use what makes you comfortable, %@. I can adjust.”
content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.quo.ja: 「前の学校のサインの方が手に馴染んでる。でも%@がやりやすい方でいこう。俺が合わせる」

content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.quo.ko: “전 학교 사인이 손에 더 붙어. 근데 {player}가 편한 쪽으로 가자. 나는 맞출 수 있어.”
content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.quo.en: “The signs from my old school still feel natural. But let us use what makes you comfortable, {player}. I can adjust.”
content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.quo.ja: 「前の学校のサインの方が手に馴染んでる。でも{player}がやりやすい方でいこう。俺が合わせる」

content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.quo.ko: “전 학교에서는 이 사인을 썼어. …어차피 네가 다 정할 거면 아무거나 해도 되고.”
content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.quo.en: “We used these signs at my old school. …If you are going to call everything anyway, use whatever.”
content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.quo.ja: 「前の学校ではこのサインを使ってた。…どうせ全部お前が決めるなら、何でもいいけど」

content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.quo.ko: “전 학교에서는 이 사인을 썼어. 우리도 다음 경기부터 바꿔 볼래?”
content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.quo.en: “We used these signs at my old school. Want to try them next game?”
content.relationship.evt-new-catcher.quo.ja: 「前の学校ではこのサインを使ってた。うちも次の試合から変えてみない？」

content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.ch.ko: 당혹감을 승부욕으로 바꿔 다음 타석에 건다
content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.ch.en: Turn the shock into a wager on the next plate appearance.
content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.ch.ja: そのショックを次の打席への賭けに変えましょう。

content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.ch.ko: 그 이름에 어울리는 공을 보여 주겠다고 한다
content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.ch.en: Promise a pitch worthy of that name
content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.ch.ja: その名にふさわしい投球を約束する

content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.ch.ko: 이상하게 보이더라도 기억의 단서를 상대와 나눈다
content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.ch.en: Share half the truth even if it sounds impossible.
content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.ch.ja: たとえ不可能に聞こえるとしても、真実の半分を共有しましょう。

content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.ch.en: Admit that the name does not exist in this life yet
content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.ch.ja: その名前はまだこの世に存在しないことを認めます

content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.ch.ko: 기억이 나만의 것인지 알아낼 실마리를 얻는다
content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.ch.en: Find a clue to whether the memory belongs to someone besides you.
content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.ch.ja: その記憶があなた以外の誰かのものかどうかを知る手がかりを見つけてください。

content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.ch.en: Press him on where he heard the nickname
content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.ch.ja: あだ名を聞いた場所を彼に押してください

content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.qu.ko: 처음 만난 상대 포수가 지난 삶의 별명을 불렀다. “왜 그렇게 봐? 다들 그렇게 부르는 줄 알았는데.”
content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.qu.en: An opposing catcher I have never met calls me by the nickname from my last life. “Why are you staring? I thought everyone called you that.”
content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.qu.ja: 会ったこともない相手捕手は私を前世のあだ名で呼んでいる。 「なんでジロジロ見てるの？みんながそう呼んでいたと思ったのに」

content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.qu.ko: 처음 만난 상대 포수가 지난 삶의 별명을 불렀다. “왜 그렇게 봐? 다들 그렇게 부르는 줄 알았는데.”
content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.qu.en: An opposing catcher I have never met calls me by the nickname from my last life. “Why are you staring? I thought everyone called you that.”
content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.qu.ja: 会ったこともない相手捕手は私を前世のあだ名で呼んでいる。 「なんでジロジロ見てるの？みんながそう呼んでいたと思ったのに」

content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.qu.ko: 처음 만난 상대 포수가 지난 삶의 별명을 불렀다. “왜 그렇게 봐? 다들 그렇게 부르는 줄 알았는데.”
content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.qu.en: An opposing catcher I have never met calls me by the nickname from my last life. “Why are you staring? I thought everyone called you that.”
content.relationship.evt-old-nickname.qu.ja: 会ったこともない相手捕手は私を前世のあだ名で呼んでいる。 「なんでジロジロ見てるの？みんながそう呼んでいたと思ったのに」

content.relationship.evt-parent-call.cho.en: Answer their worry with the next game.
content.relationship.evt-parent-call.cho.ja: 次の試合で彼らの不安に答えてください。

content.relationship.evt-parent-call.cho.en: Promise to make them proud with results
content.relationship.evt-parent-call.cho.ja: 結果を出して彼らに誇りを持ってもらうことを約束する

content.relationship.evt-parent-call.cho.en: Tell them whether you intend to keep playing.
content.relationship.evt-parent-call.cho.ja: プレイを続けるつもりかどうかを伝えてください。
冷静に計画を共有する

content.relationship.evt-parent-call.cho.ko: 드래프트 걱정에 가렸던 가족의 하루를 되찾는다
content.relationship.evt-parent-call.cho.en: Bring back the family’s day hidden behind draft worries.
content.relationship.evt-parent-call.cho.ja: ドラフトの心配の裏に隠れていた家族の一日を取り戻しましょう。

content.relationship.evt-parent-call.cho.en: Ask what happened at home today
content.relationship.evt-parent-call.cho.ja: 今日家で何があったのか聞く

content.relationship.evt-parent-call.quo.ko: “경기 봤다. 잘하더라. …드래프트 끝나고도 계속할 거지? 뭘 하든 밥은 챙겨 먹고.”
content.relationship.evt-parent-call.quo.en: “I watched the game. You did well. …You will keep playing after the draft, right? Whatever you choose, eat properly.”
content.relationship.evt-parent-call.quo.ja: 「試合、見たよ。よくやってた。…ドラフトが終わっても続けるんだろ？何をするにしても、ご飯はちゃんと食べなさい」

content.relationship.evt-parent-call.quo.ko: “요즘 연락이 없더라. …드래프트 끝나고는 어떻게 할 생각이니.”
content.relationship.evt-parent-call.quo.en: “You have not called lately. …What are you thinking after the draft?”
content.relationship.evt-parent-call.quo.ja: 「最近、連絡がないね。…ドラフトが終わったら、どうするつもりなの」

content.relationship.evt-parent-call.quo.ko: “드래프트 끝나고도 계속할 거지? …아니, 대답은 천천히 해도 돼. 밥은 챙겨 먹고 다니니.”
content.relationship.evt-parent-call.quo.en: “You are going to keep playing after the draft, right? …You do not have to answer yet. Are you eating properly?”
content.relationship.evt-parent-call.quo.ja: 「ドラフトが終わっても続けるんだろ？…いや、返事はゆっくりでいい。ご飯はちゃんと食べてるの」

content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.choi.ko: 타이밍을 빼앗는 만큼 젖은 공의 미끄러짐도 계산해야 한다
content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.choi.en: Steal the hitter’s timing while accounting for the slick ball.
content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.choi.ja: 打者のタイミングを奪う分、濡れたボールの滑りも計算に入れる

content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.choi.en: Open with the primary breaking ball
content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.choi.ja: 先頭打者から決め球の変化球を使う

content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.choi.ko: 포수가 초반 배합을 단순하게 가져갈 수 있다
content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.choi.en: Let the catcher simplify the early sequence.
content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.choi.ja: 捕手に初期のシーケンスを簡素化させます。

content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.choi.ko: 손가락 감각이 돌아올 때까지 변화구를 미룬다
content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.choi.en: Hold breaking balls until the fingers wake up
content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.choi.ja: 指の感覚が戻るまで変化球を封印する

content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.choi.ko: 재개 직후 장타보다 볼넷을 먼저 막는다
content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.choi.en: Prevent the walk before worrying about damage after the restart.
content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.choi.ja: 再起動後のダメージを心配する前に、歩行を防止してください。

content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.choi.en: Hit the mitt with a low fastball first
content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.choi.ja: まずは低めの速球をミットに打ち込む

content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.quot.ko: “%@, 네 손 아직 차갑지? 내가 낮게 붙여 줄게. 첫 공부터 같이 잡자.”
content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.quot.en: “%@, your hand is still cold, right? I will set low. We will catch the first pitch together.”
content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.quot.ja: 「%@、手はまだ冷たいだろ？低めに構えてやる。初球から一緒に取ろう」

content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.quot.ko: “{player}, 네 손 아직 차갑지? 내가 낮게 붙여 줄게. 첫 공부터 같이 잡자.”
content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.quot.en: “{player}, your hand is still cold, right? I will set low. We will catch the first pitch together.”
content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.quot.ja: 「{player}、手はまだ冷たいだろ？低めに構えてやる。初球から一緒に取ろう」

content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.quot.ko: “팔 식었는데 초구부터 세게 갈 거야? 또 사인 바꾸지 말고 지금 정해.”
content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.quot.en: “Your arm is cold and you want to open at full effort? Decide now and do not shake me off again.”
content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.quot.ja: 「腕が冷えてるのに初球から強く行くのか？またサインを変えるな、今決めろ」

content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.quot.ko: “불펜 다섯 개밖에 못 던져. 초구는 손에 가장 빨리 붙는 공으로 가자.”
content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.quot.en: “We only get five warm-up pitches. Let us open with the pitch that returns to your hand fastest.”
content.relationship.evt-rain-delay.quot.ja: 「ブルペンで5球しか投げられない。初球は一番早く手に馴染む球でいこう」

content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.ch.ko: 공은 잡지 않되 선발 경쟁의 흐름은 놓치지 않는다
content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.ch.en: Keep track of the rotation race without picking up a ball.
content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.ch.ja: ボールを拾わずにローテーションレースを追跡します。

content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.ch.ko: 경쟁자의 마지막 열 공만 곁에서 본다
content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.ch.en: Watch only the rival’s last ten pitches
content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.ch.ja: ライバルの最後の10球だけを見る

content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.ch.ko: 완전 휴식과 감각 유지 사이에서 팔 상태를 기록한다
content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.ch.en: Record the arm’s response between complete rest and keeping feel.
content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.ch.ja: 完全に休んでから感覚を維持するまでの腕の反応を記録します。

content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.ch.en: Promise to do only light band work
content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.ch.ja: ライトバンドの仕事のみを行うことを約束する

content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.ch.ko: 오늘의 불안을 견디는 대신 다음 등판의 팔 힘을 지킨다
content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.ch.en: Sit with today’s anxiety to protect tomorrow’s arm strength.
content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.ch.ja: 明日の腕の力を守るために、今日の不安を抱えてください。

content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.ch.en: Leave the glove and go to the recovery room
content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.ch.ja: 手袋を外して回復室へ行きます

content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.qu.ko: “%@, 오늘 쉬면 다음 불펜의 스무 공이 산다. 네가 그 차이를 아는 선수라고 믿는다.”
content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.qu.en: “%@, resting today saves twenty good pitches tomorrow. I trust you to know the difference.”
content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.qu.ja: 「%@、今日休めば次のブルペンの20球が生きる。その違いがわかる選手だと信じている」

content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.qu.ko: “{player}, 오늘 쉬면 다음 불펜의 스무 공이 산다. 네가 그 차이를 아는 선수라고 믿는다.”
content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.qu.en: “{player}, resting today saves twenty good pitches tomorrow. I trust you to know the difference.”
content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.qu.ja: 「{player}、今日休めば次のブルペンの20球が生きる。その違いがわかる選手だと信じている」

content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.qu.ko: “옆에서 누가 던지든 네 팔은 네 팔이야. 오늘 또 잡으면 내일부터 공이 더 무거워져.”
content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.qu.en: “Whoever is throwing next door does not change whose arm this is. Pick up a ball today and it will feel heavier tomorrow.”
content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.qu.ja: 「隣で誰が投げていようと、お前の腕はお前の腕だ。今日また握れば、明日から球が重くなる」

content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.qu.ko: “공을 놓는 날도 훈련이다. 경쟁자 불펜보다 네 회복 속도를 보자.”
content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.qu.en: “A day without a ball is training too. Watch your recovery, not your rival’s bullpen.”
content.relationship.evt-recovery-day.qu.ja: 「ボールのない日もトレーニングだ。ライバルのブルペンではなく、自分の回復に注目してほしい」。

content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.ko: 기억을 이용해 결말을 바꾸지만 또 맞으면 상처도 깊어진다
content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.en: Use the memory to change the ending, knowing another hit would cut deeper.
content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.ja: 記憶を使って結末を変える。ただ、また打たれれば傷は深くなる

content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.ko: 주도권을 잡고 공 하나 높게 승부한다
content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.en: Take control and challenge one ball higher
content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.ja: 主導権を握り、1球上のボールに挑戦する

content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.ko: 이유를 다 밝힐 수 없어도 포수와 위험을 나눈다
content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.en: Share the risk with the catcher even if you cannot explain all of it.
content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.ja: たとえすべてを説明できなくても、捕手とリスクを共有してください。

content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.ko: 이 압박이 위험할 만큼 익숙하다고 말한다
content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.en: Say this pressure feels dangerously familiar
content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.ja: このプレッシャーは危険なほど馴染みのあるものだと言う

content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.ko: 익숙한 압박 속에서도 이번 배터리와 다른 결말을 만들 기회를 연다
content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.en: Give this battery a chance to write a different ending under familiar pressure.
content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.ja: このバッテリーに、おなじみのプレッシャーの下で別の結末を書く機会を与えてください。

content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.ko: 고개를 끄덕이고 이번 삶의 포수를 믿는다
content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.en: Nod and trust this life’s catcher
content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.ja: うなずいて、この人生の捕手を信頼してください

content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.ko: 지난 삶에서 실점했던 순간과 닮은 긴장이 돌아왔다. 포수는 아무것도 모른 채 승부구 사인을 낸다. “여기, 어때?”
content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.en: The tension of a run-scoring moment from my last life returned. Knowing nothing, the catcher called the put-away pitch. “Here. How about it?”
content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.ja: 前の人生で失点した瞬間に似た緊張が戻ってきた。捕手は何も知らずに決め球のサインを出す。「ここ、どうだ？」

content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.ko: 지난 삶에서 실점했던 순간과 닮은 긴장이 돌아왔다. 포수는 아무것도 모른 채 승부구 사인을 낸다. “여기, 어때?”
content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.en: The tension of a run-scoring moment from my last life returned. Knowing nothing, the catcher called the put-away pitch. “Here. How about it?”
content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.ja: 前の人生で失点した瞬間に似た緊張が戻ってきた。捕手は何も知らずに決め球のサインを出す。「ここ、どうだ？」

content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.ko: 지난 삶에서 실점했던 순간과 닮은 긴장이 돌아왔다. 포수는 아무것도 모른 채 승부구 사인을 낸다. “여기, 어때?”
content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.en: The tension of a run-scoring moment from my last life returned. Knowing nothing, the catcher called the put-away pitch. “Here. How about it?”
content.relationship.evt-remembered-pitc.ja: 前の人生で失点した瞬間に似た緊張が戻ってきた。捕手は何も知らずに決め球のサインを出す。「ここ、どうだ？」

content.relationship.evt-rival-deja-vu.c.en: Let the next pitch settle the question.
content.relationship.evt-rival-deja-vu.c.ja: 次の提案で疑問を解決しましょう。

content.relationship.evt-rival-deja-vu.c.en: Keep the conversation grounded in this matchup.
content.relationship.evt-rival-deja-vu.c.ja: この対戦では会話をしっかりと根付かせてください。

content.relationship.evt-rival-deja-vu.c.en: Say the past does not matter
content.relationship.evt-rival-deja-vu.c.ja: 過去は関係ないと言う

content.relationship.evt-rival-deja-vu.c.en: Let the rival explain the feeling first.
content.relationship.evt-rival-deja-vu.c.ja: まずはライバルに気持ちを説明してもらいましょう。

content.relationship.evt-rival-deja-vu.c.en: Ask where he remembers me from
content.relationship.evt-rival-deja-vu.c.ja: 彼に私のことをどこから覚えているのか尋ねる

content.relationship.evt-rival-deja-vu.q.ko: 타석에 선 그가 오래 본다. “우리… 어디서 붙은 적 있나?”
content.relationship.evt-rival-deja-vu.q.en: He studies me from the box. “Have we faced each other somewhere before?”
content.relationship.evt-rival-deja-vu.q.ja: 打席の彼がじっと見てくる。「俺たち…どこかでやり合ったことあるか？」

content.relationship.evt-rival-deja-vu.q.ko: 타석에 선 그가 오래 본다. “우리… 어디서 붙은 적 있나?”
content.relationship.evt-rival-deja-vu.q.en: He studies me from the box. “Have we faced each other somewhere before?”
content.relationship.evt-rival-deja-vu.q.ja: 打席の彼がじっと見てくる。「俺たち…どこかでやり合ったことあるか？」

content.relationship.evt-rival-deja-vu.q.ko: 타석에 선 그가 오래 본다. “우리… 어디서 붙은 적 있나?”
content.relationship.evt-rival-deja-vu.q.en: He studies me from the box. “Have we faced each other somewhere before?”
content.relationship.evt-rival-deja-vu.q.ja: 打席の彼がじっと見てくる。「俺たち…どこかでやり合ったことあるか？」

content.relationship.evt-rival-final.cho.en: Answer him with the next pitch.
content.relationship.evt-rival-final.cho.ja: 次の投球で彼に答えてください。
うなずいて決闘に臨む

content.relationship.evt-rival-final.cho.en: Own the choice instead of calling it a mistake.
content.relationship.evt-rival-final.cho.ja: それを間違いだと言うのではなく、自分の選択として受け入れてください。

content.relationship.evt-rival-final.cho.en: Say the last pitch was intentional
content.relationship.evt-rival-final.cho.ja: 最後の投球が意図的だったと言う

content.relationship.evt-rival-final.cho.en: Draw out what the hitter is looking for.
content.relationship.evt-rival-final.cho.ja: 打者が求めているものを引き出す。

content.relationship.evt-rival-final.cho.en: Ask why he picked that spot
content.relationship.evt-rival-final.cho.ja: なぜその場所を選んだのか尋ねる

content.relationship.evt-rival-final.quo.ko: 타석에 들어선 그가 배트를 고쳐 쥐며 낮게 말한다. “%@. 마지막이네. 네 제일 좋은 공으로 와. 그래야 이겨도 져도 남지.”
content.relationship.evt-rival-final.quo.en: He resets his grip and speaks quietly. “%@. This is the last one. Bring your best pitch. Then neither of us will forget it.”
content.relationship.evt-rival-final.quo.ja: 打席に入った彼がバットを握り直し、低く言う。「%@。最後だな。一番いい球で来い。勝っても負けても、それなら残る」

content.relationship.evt-rival-final.quo.ko: 타석에 들어선 그가 배트를 고쳐 쥐며 낮게 말한다. “{player}. 마지막이네. 네 제일 좋은 공으로 와. 그래야 이겨도 져도 남지.”
content.relationship.evt-rival-final.quo.en: He resets his grip and speaks quietly. “{player}. This is the last one. Bring your best pitch. Then neither of us will forget it.”
content.relationship.evt-rival-final.quo.ja: 打席に入った彼がバットを握り直し、低く言う。「{player}。最後だな。一番いい球で来い。勝っても負けても、それなら残る」

content.relationship.evt-rival-final.quo.ko: 타석에 선 그가 포수 미트도 보지 않고 웃는다. “어차피 거기로 올 거잖아. 다 알아.”
content.relationship.evt-rival-final.quo.en: He smiles without looking at the catcher’s mitt. “You are throwing it there anyway. I know you.”
content.relationship.evt-rival-final.quo.ja: 打席の彼は捕手のミットも見ずに笑う。「どうせそこに来るんだろ。全部わかってる」

content.relationship.evt-rival-final.quo.ko: 타석에 들어선 그가 지난 경기와 같은 코스를 배트 끝으로 가리킨다. “또 여기로 던져 봐.”
content.relationship.evt-rival-final.quo.en: He points his bat at the same spot as last game. “Try that corner again.”
content.relationship.evt-rival-final.quo.ja: 打席に入った彼が、前の試合と同じコースをバットの先で指す。「もう一回ここに投げてみろよ」

content.relationship.evt-rival-message.c.ja: 次の対戦を設定します。

content.relationship.evt-rival-message.c.ko: 다음 타석에는 다른 답을 주겠다고 한다
content.relationship.evt-rival-message.c.en: Promise a different answer next time
content.relationship.evt-rival-message.c.ja: 次回は違う答えを約束する

content.relationship.evt-rival-message.c.en: Be honest about the plan behind the first pitch.
content.relationship.evt-rival-message.c.ja: 初球の背後にある計画について正直に話してください。

content.relationship.evt-rival-message.c.en: Explain what you wanted from that pitch
content.relationship.evt-rival-message.c.ja: その提案から何を望んでいたのか説明してください

content.relationship.evt-rival-message.c.en: Find out which pattern the rival read.
content.relationship.evt-rival-message.c.ja: ライバルがどのパターンを読んだかを調べます。
どのような習慣が見られたかを尋ねる

content.relationship.evt-rival-message.q.ko: “%@ 다음 초구, 뭐 던질지 맞혀 볼까. …아니다, 그건 직접 보는 게 낫지.”
content.relationship.evt-rival-message.q.en: “Want me to guess your next first pitch, %@? …No. I would rather see it for myself.”
content.relationship.evt-rival-message.q.ja: 「%@の次の初球、何を投げるか当ててやろうか。…いや、あれは自分の目で見た方がいいな」

content.relationship.evt-rival-message.q.ko: “{player} 다음 초구, 뭐 던질지 맞혀 볼까. …아니다, 그건 직접 보는 게 낫지.”
content.relationship.evt-rival-message.q.en: “Want me to guess your next first pitch, {player}? …No. I would rather see it for myself.”
content.relationship.evt-rival-message.q.ja: 「{player}の次の初球、何を投げるか当ててやろうか。…いや、あれは自分の目で見た方がいいな」

content.relationship.evt-rival-message.q.en: “Same first pitch again, right? …It is the only one you have.”
content.relationship.evt-rival-message.q.ja: 「また同じ初球でしょ？…それしかないよ」。

content.relationship.evt-rival-message.q.en: “Are you throwing the same first pitch next time?”
content.relationship.evt-rival-message.q.ja: 「次も同じ始球式を投げますか？」

content.relationship.evt-rival-video.cho.en: Turn the next matchup into a new test.
content.relationship.evt-rival-video.cho.ja: 次の対戦を新たな試練に変えましょう。

content.relationship.evt-rival-video.cho.ko: 다음에는 같은 높이에서 다른 공을 던지겠다고 한다
content.relationship.evt-rival-video.cho.en: Offer a different pitch at the same height
content.relationship.evt-rival-video.cho.ja: 同じ高さで異なる投球を提供

content.relationship.evt-rival-video.cho.en: Compare the read behind the pitch.
content.relationship.evt-rival-video.cho.ja: 投球裏の読みを比較してください。

content.relationship.evt-rival-video.cho.ko: 그 공으로 노렸던 것을 솔직히 말한다
content.relationship.evt-rival-video.cho.en: Tell him what you were hunting
content.relationship.evt-rival-video.cho.ja: あなたが何を狩っていたか彼に話してください

content.relationship.evt-rival-video.cho.en: Learn how long the rival has been tracking the pitch.
content.relationship.evt-rival-video.cho.ja: ライバルがどれくらいの期間投球を追跡しているかを確認します。

content.relationship.evt-rival-video.cho.en: Ask when he found the timing
content.relationship.evt-rival-video.cho.ja: いつタイミングを見つけたか尋ねる

content.relationship.evt-rival-video.quo.ko: “%@. 높은 포심, 드디어 맞췄어. …근데 이거 하나 맞추는 데 3년 걸렸다.” 영상 끝엔 웃는 표시가 붙어 있었다.
content.relationship.evt-rival-video.quo.en: “%@. I finally caught up to your high four-seam. …It took me three years to do it.” A smiley closed the clip.
content.relationship.evt-rival-video.quo.ja: 「%@。高めのフォーシーム、やっと捉えた。…これ一つ捉えるのに3年かかったけどな」動画の最後に笑顔のマークがついていた。

content.relationship.evt-rival-video.quo.ko: “{player}. 높은 포심, 드디어 맞췄어. …근데 이거 하나 맞추는 데 3년 걸렸다.” 영상 끝엔 웃는 표시가 붙어 있었다.
content.relationship.evt-rival-video.quo.en: “{player}. I finally caught up to your high four-seam. …It took me three years to do it.” A smiley closed the clip.
content.relationship.evt-rival-video.quo.ja: 「{player}。高めのフォーシーム、やっと捉えた。…これ一つ捉えるのに3年かかったけどな」動画の最後に笑顔のマークがついていた。

content.relationship.evt-rival-video.quo.ko: “네 높은 포심, 이제 안 무서워.” 헛스윙 하나 없는 타격 영상만 툭 보내왔다.
content.relationship.evt-rival-video.quo.en: “Your high four-seam does not scare me anymore.” He sent a hitting clip with not a single swing-and-miss.
content.relationship.evt-rival-video.quo.ja: 「お前の高めのフォーシーム、もう怖くない。」空振りひとつない打撃映像だけが、ぽんと送られてきた。

content.relationship.evt-rival-video.quo.ko: “높은 포심 타이밍, 이제 맞췄어.” 짧은 타격 영상이 함께 도착했다.
content.relationship.evt-rival-video.quo.en: “I have the timing on your high four-seam now.” A short hitting clip came with the message.
content.relationship.evt-rival-video.quo.ja: 「高めのフォーシーム、タイミング合わせたよ。」短い打撃映像が添えられていた。

content.relationship.evt-school-record.c.en: Answer the expectation with six more outs.
content.relationship.evt-school-record.c.ja: あと6アウトで期待に応えます。
今日それを破ると約束する

content.relationship.evt-school-record.c.en: Share what the record would mean to you.
content.relationship.evt-school-record.c.ja: この記録があなたにとって何を意味するかを共有してください。

content.relationship.evt-school-record.c.en: Tell him why you chase strikeouts
content.relationship.evt-school-record.c.ja: 三振を追う理由を教えてください

content.relationship.evt-school-record.c.en: Hear why the younger player cares about the mark.
content.relationship.evt-school-record.c.ja: 若い選手がマークを気にする理由を聞いてください。

content.relationship.evt-school-record.c.en: Ask what the record means to him
content.relationship.evt-school-record.c.ja: 彼にとってその記録が何を意味するのか尋ねる

content.relationship.evt-school-record.q.ko: “선배, 여섯 개예요. 저 오늘 그거 보려고 왔어요.”
content.relationship.evt-school-record.q.en: “Six. That is all you need. I came to see it today.”
content.relationship.evt-school-record.q.ja: 「六つ。それでいいよ。今日はそれを見に来たんだ」

content.relationship.evt-school-record.q.ko: “선배, 여섯 개만 더 잡으면 학교 기록이래요. …아, 부담 드리려던 건 아니고요.”
content.relationship.evt-school-record.q.en: “Six more strikeouts and it is a school record. …I am not trying to pressure you.”
content.relationship.evt-school-record.q.ja: 「あと6三振で、これは学校記録だ。…プレッシャーをかけるつもりはない。」

content.relationship.evt-school-record.q.ko: “선배, 다음 경기에서 여섯 개만 더 잡으면 학교 기록이래요. …저 그거 옆에서 보고 싶어요.”
content.relationship.evt-school-record.q.en: “Six more strikeouts next game and you change the school record. …I want to watch it happen.”
content.relationship.evt-school-record.q.ja: 「次の試合であと6三振を取れば、学校記録が塗り替えられる。…それが起こるのを見たい。」

content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.ko: 고교 기록을 끝으로 보지 않고 다음 마운드의 여백으로 둔다
content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.en: Treat the high-school record as space for the next mound, not an ending.
content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.ja: 高校時代の記録を終わりではなく、次のマウンドへのスペースとして扱いましょう。

content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.ko: 빈 마지막 장은 남겨 둔 채 덮는다
content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.en: Close it with the last page still blank
content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.ja: 最後のページを白紙のまま閉じます

content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.ko: 다음 팀에서도 흔들릴 때 돌아올 기준을 만든다
content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.en: Leave a checkpoint to return to when the next team gets difficult.
content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.ja: 次のチームが難しくなったときに戻るチェックポイントを残しておきます。

content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.ko: 배운 한 문장을 표지 안쪽에 적는다
content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.en: Write one lesson inside the cover
content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.ja: 表紙の内側にレッスンを 1 つ書きます

content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.ko: 좋은 기록만이 아니라 버틴 과정까지 다음 삶의 기억으로 남긴다
content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.en: Carry the endurance, not only the good numbers, into the next life.
content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.ja: 良い数字だけでなく、忍耐も次の人生に持ち込んでください。

content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.en: Mark the hardest game with a star too
content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.ja: 最も難しい試合にも星を付けてください

content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.ko: 마지막 장을 덮기 전, 가장 좋았던 경기와 다시 일어선 경기에 같은 표시를 남겼다.
content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.en: Before closing the last page, I marked both the best game and the game where I got back up.
content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.ja: 最後のページを閉じる前に、最高の試合と立ち直った試合の両方にマークを付けました。

content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.ko: 잘 던진 날과 무너진 날 사이에 빈칸이 많다. 마지막 표시를 어디에 둘지 쉽게 정해지지 않는다.
content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.en: There were too many blank spaces between the best game and the collapse. Choosing the final mark was not easy.
content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.ja: 最高の試合と崩壊の間には空白が多すぎた。最終的なマークを選択するのは簡単ではありませんでした。

content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.ko: 세 해의 스코어북을 넘기자 숫자보다 그날의 미트 소리가 먼저 돌아온다.
content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.en: Turning three years of scorebook pages brought back mitt sounds before numbers.
content.relationship.evt-scorebook-close.ja: 3年間のスコアブックのページをめくると、数字より先にミット音が戻ってきた。

content.relationship.evt-scout-question..en: Let the next pitch make the case.
content.relationship.evt-scout-question..ja: 次の投球でそれを証明しましょう。

content.relationship.evt-scout-question..en: Show the best pitch you have
content.relationship.evt-scout-question..ja: あなたが持っている最高の投球を見せてください

content.relationship.evt-scout-question..en: Give the scout evidence from your adjustment.
content.relationship.evt-scout-question..ja: スカウトに調整の証拠を提出してください。

content.relationship.evt-scout-question..ko: 그 경기 뒤 바꾼 것을 말한다
content.relationship.evt-scout-question..ja: 何が変わったのか説明してください

content.relationship.evt-scout-question..ko: 다음 등판에서 바꿀 평가 항목을 하나 얻는다
content.relationship.evt-scout-question..en: Leave with one evaluation line to change next start.
content.relationship.evt-scout-question..ja: 評価行を 1 つ残して次の開始を変更します。

content.relationship.evt-scout-question..ko: 보고서에서 멈춘 장면을 가리켜 달라 한다
content.relationship.evt-scout-question..en: Ask the scout to point to the frame that stopped him
content.relationship.evt-scout-question..ja: スカウトに、彼を止めたフレームを指してもらいます

content.relationship.evt-scout-question..ko: “%@. 지난달 그 경기 뒤로 확실히 달라졌더라. 뭘 바꿨는지 듣고 싶어서 왔다.”
content.relationship.evt-scout-question..en: “%@, you are clearly different since that game last month. I came to hear what changed.”
content.relationship.evt-scout-question..ja: 「%@、あなたは先月の試合から明らかに変わりました。何が変わったのか聞きに来ました。」

content.relationship.evt-scout-question..ko: “{player}. 지난달 그 경기 뒤로 확실히 달라졌더라. 뭘 바꿨는지 듣고 싶어서 왔다.”
content.relationship.evt-scout-question..en: “{player}, you are clearly different since that game last month. I came to hear what changed.”
content.relationship.evt-scout-question..ja: 「{player}、あなたは先月の試合から明らかに変わりました。何が変わったのか聞きに来ました。」

content.relationship.evt-scout-question..ko: “지난달 그 경기 봤다. …그 뒤로 뭘 바꿨나?”
content.relationship.evt-scout-question..en: “I watched that game last month. …What did you change afterward?”
content.relationship.evt-scout-question..ja: 「先月その試合を観ました。…その後、何を変えましたか？」

content.relationship.evt-scout-question..ko: “지난달 무너진 경기 다음에, 뭘 바꿨지? …바꾼 게 있다면 그게 제일 궁금해.”
content.relationship.evt-scout-question..en: “After that collapse last month, what did you change? …That is what I am most interested in.”
content.relationship.evt-scout-question..ja: 「先月の崩壊の後、あなたは何を変えましたか？…それが私が最も興味があることです。」

content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.cho.ko: 최고 수치를 노리지만 힘이 빠진 뒤의 제구도 함께 드러난다
content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.cho.en: Chase the top reading while exposing late-session command too.
content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.cho.ja: 最高球速を狙うが、力が落ちた後の制球も一緒に見られる

content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.cho.en: Drive through the final pitch at full effort
content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.cho.ja: 最終投球を全力で駆け抜ける

content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.cho.ko: 힘자랑이 아니라 계획대로 던진다는 점을 평가표에 남긴다
content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.cho.en: Show the report that you are following a plan, not merely showing off.
content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.cho.ja: 単に見せびらかすだけでなく、計画に従っていることを報告書に示してください。

content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.cho.ko: 오늘 점검할 구종 순서를 먼저 밝힌다
content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.cho.en: State the pitch sequence you are evaluating today
content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.cho.ja: 今日評価している投球シーケンスを述べてください

content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.cho.ko: 한 번의 최고 구속보다 재현성을 평가표에 남긴다
content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.cho.en: Put repeatability, not a single top speed, on the report.
content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.cho.ja: 単一の最高速度ではなく、再現性をレポートに記載します。

content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.cho.ko: 전광판을 보지 않고 같은 코스를 반복한다
content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.cho.en: Repeat the same location without looking at the board
content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.cho.ja: ボードを見ずに同じコースを繰り返す

content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.quo.ko: “%@, 첫 공은 충분히 빨랐다. 이제 마지막 공까지 네 투구인지 보여 줘.”
content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.quo.en: “%@, the first pitch was fast enough. Show me the final pitch still belongs to you.”
content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.quo.ja: 「%@、初球は十分に速かった。最後の球はまだあなたのものであることを見せてください。」

content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.quo.ko: “{player}, 첫 공은 충분히 빨랐다. 이제 마지막 공까지 네 투구인지 보여 줘.”
content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.quo.en: “{player}, the first pitch was fast enough. Show me the final pitch still belongs to you.”
content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.quo.ja: 「{player}、初球は十分に速かった。最後の球はまだあなたのものであることを見せてください。」

content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.quo.ko: “전광판 숫자 말고도 적을 건 많아. 같은 동작으로 다시 던질 수 있는지 보지.”
content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.quo.en: “There is more to write than the radar reading. I watch whether you can repeat the delivery.”
content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.quo.ja: 「スコアボードの数字以外にも書くことは多い。同じフォームでもう一度投げられるか、見せてもらう」

content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.quo.ko: “구속은 이미 봤다. 힘 빠진 뒤에도 포수 무릎으로 가는지가 오늘 질문이야.”
content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.quo.en: “I have already seen the velocity. Today’s question is whether you still hit the catcher’s knee when tired.”
content.relationship.evt-scout-stand.quo.ja: 「球速はもう見ています。今日の問題は、疲れても捕手の膝に当たるかどうかです」。

content.relationship.evt-second-summer.c.en: Use what you know to make a different choice.
content.relationship.evt-second-summer.c.ja: 知っていることを利用して、別の選択をしてください。

content.relationship.evt-second-summer.c.en: Name the parts of the summer that feel known.
content.relationship.evt-second-summer.c.ja: 夏の特徴として知られている部分を挙げてください。
私が覚えていることを説明してください
おなじみの季節が広がります。

content.relationship.evt-second-summer.q.ko: 같은 계절, 같은 대회. 이번에는 무엇이 오는지 알고 서 있다.
content.relationship.evt-second-summer.q.en: Same season, same tournament. This time I am standing here knowing what is coming.
content.relationship.evt-second-summer.q.ja: 同じシーズン、同じトーナメント。今回、私は何が起こるかを知ってここに立っている。

content.relationship.evt-second-summer.q.ko: 같은 계절, 같은 대회. 이번에는 무엇이 오는지 알고 서 있다.
content.relationship.evt-second-summer.q.en: Same season, same tournament. This time I am standing here knowing what is coming.
content.relationship.evt-second-summer.q.ja: 同じシーズン、同じトーナメント。今回、私は何が起こるかを知ってここに立っている。

content.relationship.evt-second-summer.q.ko: 같은 계절, 같은 대회. 이번에는 무엇이 오는지 알고 서 있다.
content.relationship.evt-second-summer.q.en: Same season, same tournament. This time I am standing here knowing what is coming.
content.relationship.evt-second-summer.q.ja: 同じシーズン、同じトーナメント。今回、私は何が起こるかを知ってここに立っている。

content.relationship.evt-team-slump.choi.ko: 팀을 한데 묶는 만큼 지친 동료를 설득할 책임도 진다
content.relationship.evt-team-slump.choi.en: Unite the team and take responsibility for persuading tired teammates.
content.relationship.evt-team-slump.choi.ja: チームを団結させ、疲れたチームメイトを説得する責任を負います。

content.relationship.evt-team-slump.choi.ko: 내일부터 전원이 같은 시간에 나오자고 한다
content.relationship.evt-team-slump.choi.en: Call everyone in at the same time tomorrow
content.relationship.evt-team-slump.choi.ja: 明日は同じ時間に全員に電話してください

content.relationship.evt-team-slump.choi.ko: 연패 속 과훈련을 막되 준비 부족의 책임은 투수조가 진다
content.relationship.evt-team-slump.choi.en: Avoid overtraining while the pitching group owns the preparation risk.
content.relationship.evt-team-slump.choi.ja: 投手陣が準備のリスクを抱えている間は、オーバートレーニングを避けてください。

content.relationship.evt-team-slump.choi.en: Propose a short, focused bullpen for the pitchers
content.relationship.evt-team-slump.choi.ja: 投手に短く集中したブルペンを提案する

content.relationship.evt-team-slump.choi.ko: 서로 다른 불만을 먼저 모아 훈련 파행을 막는다
content.relationship.evt-team-slump.choi.en: Collect the different complaints before the training plan splits apart.
content.relationship.evt-team-slump.choi.ja: トレーニング計画がバラバラになる前に、さまざまな苦情を収集します。

content.relationship.evt-team-slump.choi.ko: 각 포지션이 필요한 시간을 차례로 받는다
content.relationship.evt-team-slump.choi.en: Ask each position group how much time it needs
content.relationship.evt-team-slump.choi.ja: 各ポジショングループにどれくらいの時間がかかるかを尋ねます

content.relationship.evt-team-slump.quot.ko: “%@, 투수조가 먼저 방향을 잡아 줘. 지금은 네 한마디를 다들 기다린다.”
content.relationship.evt-team-slump.quot.en: “%@, give the pitching group a direction first. Everyone is waiting for your word.”
content.relationship.evt-team-slump.quot.ja: 「%@、まず投手陣に方向性を与えてください。みんながあなたの言葉を待っています。」

content.relationship.evt-team-slump.quot.ko: “{player}, 투수조가 먼저 방향을 잡아 줘. 지금은 네 한마디를 다들 기다린다.”
content.relationship.evt-team-slump.quot.en: “{player}, give the pitching group a direction first. Everyone is waiting for your word.”
content.relationship.evt-team-slump.quot.ja: 「{player}、まず投手陣に方向性を与えてください。みんながあなたの言葉を待っています。」

content.relationship.evt-team-slump.quot.ko: “세 번 졌다고 각자 하겠다는 게 팀이냐. 네 불펜부터 시간 맞춰.”
content.relationship.evt-team-slump.quot.en: “Three losses and everyone wants to work alone? Match your bullpen time first.”
content.relationship.evt-team-slump.quot.ja: 「3敗で誰もが一人で頑張りたいと思う？ まずはブルペンの時間を合わせよう。」

content.relationship.evt-team-slump.quot.ko: “자율 훈련을 늘릴지, 다 같이 일찍 끝낼지 정해야 해. 말 없는 사람도 책임은 같아.”
content.relationship.evt-team-slump.quot.en: “We need to choose: more individual work or everyone leaving early. Silence does not remove responsibility.”
content.relationship.evt-team-slump.quot.ja: 「自主練を増やすか、全員で早く切り上げるか決めないと。黙ってる人も責任は同じだ」

content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..ko: 도망치지 않지만 같은 침묵이 오면 정면으로 견뎌야 한다
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..en: Refuse to run, knowing the same silence may have to be faced directly.
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..ja: 逃げはしない。ただ同じ沈黙が来たら、正面から耐えるしかない

content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..ko: 전화기를 손에 쥔 채 끝까지 자리를 지킨다
