content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..en: Hold the phone and stay until the end
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..ja: 電話を握って最後までいてください

content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..ko: 혼자 버티던 지난 삶과 달리 방 안의 긴장을 함께 나눈다
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..en: Share the room’s tension instead of carrying it alone as before.
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..ja: 部屋の緊張感をこれまでのように一人で抱え込むのではなく、共有しましょう。

content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..ko: 가족에게 잠시 창문을 열어 달라고 한다
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..en: Ask the family to open the window
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..ja: 家族に窓を開けてもらう

content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..ko: 과거의 결말이 현재의 모든 이름을 삼키지 않게 한다
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..en: Keep the old ending from swallowing every name in the present.
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..ja: 古い結末が現在のあらゆる名前を飲み込まないようにしてください。

content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..ko: 숨을 세 번 고르고 첫 순서를 지켜본다
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..en: Take three breaths and watch the first selection
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..ja: 三呼吸して最初の選択を見てください

content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..ko: 중계 화면이 켜지자 이름이 끝내 불리지 않았던 방의 공기가 먼저 돌아왔다. 아직 첫 순서도 시작하지 않았다.
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..en: The moment the broadcast turns on, the air from the room where my name was never called returns. The first selection has not begun.
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..ja: 中継画面がつくと、最後まで名前を呼ばれなかった部屋の空気が先に戻ってきた。まだ一巡目も始まっていない。

content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..ko: 중계 화면이 켜지자 이름이 끝내 불리지 않았던 방의 공기가 먼저 돌아왔다. 아직 첫 순서도 시작하지 않았다.
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..en: The moment the broadcast turns on, the air from the room where my name was never called returns. The first selection has not begun.
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..ja: 中継画面がつくと、最後まで名前を呼ばれなかった部屋の空気が先に戻ってきた。まだ一巡目も始まっていない。

content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..ko: 중계 화면이 켜지자 이름이 끝내 불리지 않았던 방의 공기가 먼저 돌아왔다. 아직 첫 순서도 시작하지 않았다.
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..en: The moment the broadcast turns on, the air from the room where my name was never called returns. The first selection has not begun.
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-deja..ja: 中継画面がつくと、最後まで名前を呼ばれなかった部屋の空気が先に戻ってきた。まだ一巡目も始まっていない。

content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..ko: 진로가 정해지지 않아도 선수의 하루는 멈추지 않는다
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..en: Keep the player’s day moving even before the next path is certain.
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..ja: 次の道が決まる前であっても、プレイヤーの一日を前進させ続けましょう。

content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..en: Leave the dawn workout alarm on
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..ja: 夜明けのトレーニングアラームはオンのままにしておきます

content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..ko: 상실감이 가라앉기 전 다음 야구의 문을 만든다
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..en: Open the next door in baseball before the loss settles in.
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..ja: 負けが定着する前に野球の次の扉を開けましょう。

content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..en: Write down the teams and schools to call tomorrow
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..ja: 明日電話するチームと学校を書き留めてください

content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..ko: 탈락의 밤을 실패 한 줄로만 남기지 않는다
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..en: Refuse to reduce the night to a single line of failure.
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..ja: 夜を単一の失敗の行に縮小することを拒否してください。

content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..ko: 가장 버텨 낸 경기 페이지를 펼친다
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..en: Open the page from the game you endured best
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..ja: 一番耐えた試合のページを開く

content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..ko: 이름은 불리지 않았다. 그래도 세 해 동안 쌓은 공이 사라진 것은 아니었다. 다음 마운드를 고를 차례다.
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..en: My name was not called, but three years of pitches had not vanished. It was time to choose the next mound.
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..ja: 名前は呼ばれなかったが、３年間の投球の成果は消えなかった。次のマウンドを選択する時期が来た。

content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..ko: 마지막 이름까지 지나갔다. 방 안에는 꺼지지 않은 중계 화면과 세 해의 숫자만 남았다.
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..en: The final name passed. Only the glowing broadcast and three years of numbers remained in the room.
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..ja: 最後の名前まで過ぎた。部屋には消えない中継画面と、3年分の数字だけが残った。

content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..ko: 전화는 오지 않았다. 스코어북을 펴자 잘 던진 날보다 다시 던진 날이 먼저 보였다.
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..en: No call came. When I opened the scorebook, the days I returned stood out before the days I dominated.
content.relationship.evt-undrafted-room..ja: 電話は来なかった。スコアブックを開くと、よく投げた日より、もう一度投げた日が先に目に入った。

content.relationship.evt-velocity-drop.c.en: Accept the risk and try to hold the line.
content.relationship.evt-velocity-drop.c.ja: リスクを受け入れて、一線を保持するように努めてください。

content.relationship.evt-velocity-drop.c.en: Explain what your body has felt between outings.
content.relationship.evt-velocity-drop.c.ja: 登板の間に体が何を感じたか説明してください。

content.relationship.evt-velocity-drop.c.ko: 구속 저하가 시작된 몸의 신호를 놓치지 않는다
content.relationship.evt-velocity-drop.c.en: Catch the body signal that began with the velocity drop.
content.relationship.evt-velocity-drop.c.ja: 速度の低下から始まる身体の信号をキャッチします。

content.relationship.evt-velocity-drop.c.ko: 팔이 늦어지는 동작을 짚어 달라 한다
content.relationship.evt-velocity-drop.c.en: Ask the trainer to point out where the arm falls behind
content.relationship.evt-velocity-drop.c.ja: トレーナーに腕が後ろに下がっている場所を指摘してもらいます

content.relationship.evt-velocity-drop.q.ko: “두 경기째 2km/h. 네가 먼저 느꼈을 거라 생각하는데, 어때?”
content.relationship.evt-velocity-drop.q.en: “1.2 mph in two straight games. I thought you would feel it before anyone else. How does it feel?”
content.relationship.evt-velocity-drop.q.ja: 「2試合連続で時速1.2マイル。誰よりも早く感じると思っていたけど、どんな感じ？」

content.relationship.evt-velocity-drop.q.ko: “두 경기째 구속이 빠졌어. …말해도 안 들을 거면 기록만 남겨 둘게.”
content.relationship.evt-velocity-drop.q.en: “Your velocity is down for the second straight game. …If you will not listen, I will just keep the record.”
content.relationship.evt-velocity-drop.q.ja: 「あなたの速度は2試合連続で落ちています。…聞いてくれないなら、記録だけ残しておきます。」

content.relationship.evt-velocity-drop.q.ko: “두 경기째 구속이 2km/h 빠졌어. 숫자는 거짓말을 안 해. 몸이 뭔가 말하는 중이야.”
content.relationship.evt-velocity-drop.q.en: “You are down 1.2 mph for the second straight game. Numbers do not lie. Your body is saying something.”
content.relationship.evt-velocity-drop.q.ja: 「2試合連続で時速1.2マイルを落としている。数字は嘘をつかない。体が何かを訴えている。」

content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.c.ko: 구속 상승을 노리지만 뻣뻣해진 몸을 다시 풀 부담도 떠안는다
content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.c.en: Chase more velocity while accepting the work needed to loosen up again.
content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.c.ja: 再び緩めるために必要な作業を受け入れながら、さらなる速度を追求します。

content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.c.ko: 이번 겨울은 힘을 붙이는 데 건다
content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.c.en: Commit the winter to building strength
content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.c.ja: 冬は体力づくりに専念する

content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.c.ko: 기록표를 남겨 힘과 가동 범위가 무너지는 지점을 찾는다
content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.c.en: Track the point where strength starts costing mobility.
content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.c.ja: 体力が機動力を犠牲にし始めるポイントを追跡します。

content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.c.en: Propose adding lower-body weight in stages
content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.c.ja: 下半身の重量を段階的に追加することを提案する

content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.c.ko: 겨울 내내 같은 팔의 길을 보존해 투구 동작이 굳는 일을 막는다
content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.c.en: Keep the same arm path all winter so the delivery does not stiffen.
content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.c.ja: 冬の間ずっと同じ腕の軌道を保ち、投球フォームが固まるのを防ぐ

content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.c.en: Protect the shoulder angle over the squat number
content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.c.ja: スクワット数を越えて肩の角度を守る

content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.q.ko: “%@, 네 몸은 힘을 받을 준비가 됐다. 다만 지금의 부드러운 팔의 길도 자산이야. 네가 골라.”
content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.q.en: “%@, your body is ready to add strength. But this easy arm path is an asset too. You choose.”
content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.q.ja: 「%@、体は力を受け入れる準備ができている。ただ、今の柔らかい腕の軌道も財産だ。お前が選べ」

content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.q.ko: “{player}, 네 몸은 힘을 받을 준비가 됐다. 다만 지금의 부드러운 팔의 길도 자산이야. 네가 골라.”
content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.q.en: “{player}, your body is ready to add strength. But this easy arm path is an asset too. You choose.”
content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.q.ja: 「{player}、体は力を受け入れる準備ができている。ただ、今の柔らかい腕の軌道も財産だ。お前が選べ」

content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.q.ko: “무게만 좇으면 네 어깨 회전이 먼저 닫힌다. 그래도 숫자만 볼 거냐?”
content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.q.en: “If you chase weight alone, your shoulder rotation will close first. Are you still going to watch only the numbers?”
content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.q.ja: 「体重だけを追うと肩の回転が先に閉じてしまう。それでも数字だけを見るのか？」

content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.q.ko: “하체 힘을 더 붙일 수도 있고, 지금 가동 범위를 지킬 수도 있어. 둘 다 한꺼번에는 어렵다.”
content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.q.en: “We can add lower-body strength or protect your current mobility. Doing both at once will be difficult.”
content.relationship.evt-winter-weight.q.ja: 「下半身の筋力を強化することも、現在の可動性を保護することもできます。両方を同時に行うのは難しいでしょう。」

content.relationship.fallback.choice.cha.en: Risky, but success can bring a bigger ability boost.

content.training-focus.breaking_ball.det.ko: 변화구가 오릅니다. 공이 더 꺾이고 떨어집니다.
content.training-focus.breaking_ball.det.en: Improves the break and drop on your breaking ball.
content.training-focus.breaking_ball.det.ja: 変化球が伸びます。ボールがより曲がり、より落ちます。

content.training-focus.breaking_ball.tra.ko: 고른 결정구만 빠르게 완성합니다. 강하게 할수록 팔 위험이 조금 오릅니다.
content.training-focus.breaking_ball.tra.en: Polishes only the breaking ball you choose. Higher intensity adds a little arm risk.
content.training-focus.breaking_ball.tra.ja: 選んだ決め球だけを速く仕上げます。強度を上げるほど、腕のリスクが少し増えます。

content.training-focus.command.detail.ja: 制球をシャープにします。

content.training-focus.command.tradeoff.ko: 성장 편차와 피로가 작고 팔 위험이 없지만 대성공은 드뭅니다.
content.training-focus.command.tradeoff.en: Steadier gains and low fatigue with no arm risk, but fewer huge breakthroughs.
content.training-focus.command.tradeoff.ja: 安定したゲインと疲労の少なさで腕のリスクはありませんが、大きな突破口は少なくなります。

content.training-focus.game_planning.det.en: Improves battery timing and matchup decisions.
content.training-focus.game_planning.det.ja: バッテリーのタイミングと対戦の決定を改善します。

content.training-focus.game_planning.met.ja: 打者の組み合わせと指揮

content.training-focus.game_planning.tra.ko: 가벼운 피로로 제구를 다듬지만 구종 자체 위력은 오르지 않습니다.
content.training-focus.game_planning.tra.en: Sharpens command with light fatigue, but does not increase pitch stuff.
content.training-focus.game_planning.tra.ja: 軽い疲労で制球が鋭くなりますが、投球は増加しません。

content.training-focus.recovery.detail.en: Reduces fatigue and helps your arm recover.
content.training-focus.recovery.detail.ja: 疲労を軽減し、腕の回復を助けます。

content.training-focus.recovery.tradeoff.ko: 능력 성장은 없고 피로와 팔 상태를 회복합니다.
content.training-focus.recovery.tradeoff.en: No rating growth; restores fatigue and arm health.
content.training-focus.recovery.tradeoff.ja: 評価は伸びません。疲労と腕の健康を回復します。

content.training-focus.stamina.detail.ja: スタミナを強化します。

content.training-focus.stamina.tradeoff.ko: 후반 체감 피로를 낮춥니다. 당장의 구속·결정구는 오르지 않습니다.
content.training-focus.stamina.tradeoff.en: Makes late-inning fatigue easier to handle, but does not raise stuff or your putaway pitch today.
content.training-focus.stamina.tradeoff.ja: イニング終盤の疲労に対処しやすくなりますが、今日の投球や投球は上がりません。

content.training-focus.velocity.detail.ko: 구위가 오릅니다. 직구가 빨라지고 헛스윙이 늘어납니다. 피로가 큽니다.
content.training-focus.velocity.detail.en: Builds stuff, adds life to the fastball, and creates more whiffs—but costs fatigue.
content.training-focus.velocity.detail.ja: 球威が上がります。速球が速くなり、空振りが増えます。疲労は大きめです。

content.training-focus.velocity.tradeoff.ko: 대성공 가능성과 성장 편차가 가장 크지만 피로·팔 위험도 가장 큽니다.
content.training-focus.velocity.tradeoff.en: Biggest upside and widest growth swings, with the highest fatigue and arm risk.
content.training-focus.velocity.tradeoff.ja: 最も大きな上昇幅と最も大きな成長の振れ幅があり、疲労と腕のリスクが最も高くなります。

content.training-opportunity.breaking_ba.ko: 어제 변화구 회전이 좋았다. 오늘 확실히 내 것으로 만들자.
content.training-opportunity.breaking_ba.en: Yesterday's break was sharp. Make that pitch yours today.
content.training-opportunity.breaking_ba.ja: 昨日の休みはきつかったです。今日、その提案を自分のものにしてみましょう。

content.training-opportunity.breaking_ba.ko: 손끝 감각이 살아 있다. 변화구를 다듬을 기회다.
content.training-opportunity.breaking_ba.en: Your fingertips are alive. This is the day to refine the breaker.
content.training-opportunity.breaking_ba.ja: あなたの指先は生きています。今日はブレーカーを改良する日です。

content.training-opportunity.breaking_ba.ko: 타자들이 변화구에 늦게 반응했다. 오늘 더 벼리자.
content.training-opportunity.breaking_ba.en: Hitters were late on the breaking ball. Sharpen it again today.
content.training-opportunity.breaking_ba.ja: 打者は変化球で出遅れた。今日も研ぎます。

content.training-opportunity.breaking_ba.ko: 변화구는 하루 쉬면 이틀 도망간다. 오늘 다시 잡아 두자.
content.training-opportunity.breaking_ba.en: A breaking ball slips two days for every day off. Pin it back down today.
content.training-opportunity.breaking_ba.ja: 変化球は一日休むと二日逃げる。今日のうちに取り戻そう。

content.training-opportunity.command.rea.ko: 포수가 미트를 거의 안 움직였다. 코스 훈련이 먹힐 날이다.
content.training-opportunity.command.rea.en: The catcher barely had to move the glove. Your location work is ready.
content.training-opportunity.command.rea.ja: 捕手はグラブをほとんど動かす必要がなかった。コース作業の準備が整いました。

content.training-opportunity.command.rea.ko: 던지는 리듬이 잡혔다. 오늘 존 구석을 노리자.
content.training-opportunity.command.rea.en: Your delivery rhythm is locked in. Work the corners today.
content.training-opportunity.command.rea.ja: あなたの配達リズムは固定されています。今日は隅々まで取り組みましょう。

content.training-opportunity.command.rea.ko: 밸런스가 좋다. 원하는 곳에 꽂는 연습을 늘리자.
content.training-opportunity.command.rea.en: Your balance is clean. Put more reps into hitting your spots.
content.training-opportunity.command.rea.ja: バランスはきれいです。スポットを当てるために繰り返し回数を増やしましょう。

content.training-opportunity.command.rea.ko: 제구는 감이 아니라 반복이다. 오늘도 같은 코스에 쌓자.
content.training-opportunity.command.rea.en: Command isn't a feeling — it's repetition. Stack the same corner again today.
content.training-opportunity.command.rea.ja: 制球は感覚ではなく反復だ。今日も同じコースに積み重ねよう。

content.training-opportunity.game_planni.ko: 상대 타선 기록이 도착했다. 오늘 파고들자.
content.training-opportunity.game_planni.en: The opponent's lineup notes just arrived. Dig in today.
content.training-opportunity.game_planni.ja: 相手のラインナップノートが届きました。今日は掘り下げてみましょう。

content.training-opportunity.game_planni.ko: 포수와 사인을 맞출 시간이 났다. 수 싸움을 늘리자.
content.training-opportunity.game_planni.en: You have time to sync with the catcher. Add to the game plan.
content.training-opportunity.game_planni.ja: 捕手とシンクロする時間があります。試合プランに追加します。

content.training-opportunity.game_planni.ko: 경기 감각이 올라 있다. 상대 분석이 잘 먹힌다.
content.training-opportunity.game_planni.en: Your game feel is sharp. Opponent study should pay off today.
content.training-opportunity.game_planni.ja: 試合感覚が鋭いですね。今日は相手の研究が報われるはずだ。

content.training-opportunity.game_planni.ko: 몸이 쉬는 날에도 머리는 던질 수 있다. 배합을 정리해 두자.
content.training-opportunity.game_planni.en: Even on a slow day, the mind can pitch. Get the sequences in order.
content.training-opportunity.game_planni.ja: 体を休める日でも、頭は投げられる。配球を整理しておこう。

content.training-opportunity.recovery.re.ko: 팔이 무겁다는 신호다. 오늘은 회복이 최고의 훈련이다.
content.training-opportunity.recovery.re.en: Your arm is sending a heavy signal. Recovery is the best work today.
content.training-opportunity.recovery.re.ja: あなたの腕は重い信号を送っています。今日はリカバリーが一番の仕事です。

content.training-opportunity.recovery.re.ko: 쉬는 것도 실력이다. 몸을 만들 날이다.
content.training-opportunity.recovery.re.en: Rest is part of the craft. Build your body back today.
content.training-opportunity.recovery.re.ja: 休息も仕事の一部です。今日から体を作り直しましょう。

content.training-opportunity.recovery.re.ko: 피로가 쌓였다. 오늘 회복하면 내일이 달라진다.
content.training-opportunity.recovery.re.en: Fatigue has piled up. Recover today and tomorrow changes.
content.training-opportunity.recovery.re.ja: 疲労が溜まってきました。今日を回復すれば、明日は変わります。

content.training-opportunity.recovery.re.ko: 팔은 정직하다. 오늘 쉬어 준 만큼 다음 공이 산다.
content.training-opportunity.recovery.re.en: The arm is honest. The rest you give it today lives in your next pitch.
content.training-opportunity.recovery.re.ja: 腕は正直だ。今日休ませた分だけ、次の球が生きる。

content.training-opportunity.stamina.rea.ko: 긴 이닝을 버틸 몸을 만들 적기다.
content.training-opportunity.stamina.rea.en: This is the right time to build a body that can carry deep outings.
content.training-opportunity.stamina.rea.ja: 深い登板もできる体を作るのに最適な時期です。

content.training-opportunity.stamina.rea.ko: 회복이 빨라졌다. 오늘 체력 훈련이 잘 붙는다.
content.training-opportunity.stamina.rea.en: You are recovering faster. Stamina work should stick today.
content.training-opportunity.stamina.rea.ja: 回復が早くなってきた。今日はスタミナ練習がよく身につく。

content.training-opportunity.stamina.rea.ko: 다음 등판까지 여유가 있다. 체력을 쌓자.
content.training-opportunity.stamina.rea.en: There is time before your next outing. Bank some stamina.
content.training-opportunity.stamina.rea.ja: 次の登板まで時間はあります。スタミナを蓄えておきましょう。

content.training-opportunity.stamina.rea.ko: 여름의 7회는 겨울의 하체가 던진다. 오늘 쌓아 두자.
content.training-opportunity.stamina.rea.en: Summer's seventh inning is thrown by winter's legs. Build them today.
content.training-opportunity.stamina.rea.ja: 夏の7回は、冬の下半身が投げる。今日積み上げておこう。

content.training-opportunity.velocity.re.ko: 어제 불펜에서 팔 스윙이 가벼웠다. 오늘 직구를 밀어붙이자.
content.training-opportunity.velocity.re.en: Your arm path felt loose in the bullpen yesterday. Attack the fastball today.

setup.soul-domain.body.detail.ko: 구위와 체력에 먼저 들어갑니다. 긴 이닝을 버티는 쪽입니다.
setup.soul-domain.body.detail.en: Stuff and stamina come first. Build the arm to last deep into games.
setup.soul-domain.body.detail.ja: 球威とスタミナが第一です。試合に長く耐えられる腕を鍛えましょう。

setup.soul-domain.game.detail.ko: 제구와 타자 상대법에 먼저 들어갑니다. 수 싸움으로 버티는 쪽입니다.

setup.soul-domain.rule.ja: 半分は最初に選択したエリアに行きます。残りはあなたの最低の能力を補います。才能制限は依然として適用されます。

setup.soul-domain.technique.detail.ko: 제구와 변화구에 먼저 들어갑니다. 원하는 곳에 꽂는 쪽입니다.
setup.soul-domain.technique.detail.en: Command and breaking balls come first. Put the pitch where you want it.
setup.soul-domain.technique.detail.ja: 制球と変化球から先に伸びます。狙った場所に投げ込むタイプです。
